IGUI_ChuckAlertDonationMsg:
While I deeply enjoy modding, it requires significant time and energy, and I need to balance it with other responsibilities, particularly financial ones. To make it clear, I will continue to maintain, support, troubleshoot, and update my mods as I always have. However, these other priorities must come first.

This same situation can apply to almost all modders, and you may find support buttons for each respective mod listed here. These buttons are customizable and set by the mod-authors. If you’ve enjoyed any mod-author’s hardwork and dedication and would like to support it, consider doing so.

Personally, donations make it more feasible for me to dedicate time and effort to my projects. That said, there’s absolutely no pressure; please only donate if you’re comfortable and able. For me, your enjoyment of my mods is already a tremendous reward.

Thank you for your support and understanding!

IGUI_Instruments_Band: Band Play: Once all players are ready, have one member of your group hold down the 'X' key for a few seconds to start the song.
IGUI_Instruments_Band_Body: Group performances are a unique and engaging mechanic that lets players collaborate musically in-game. By forming a band with friends, you can play coordinated songs using different instruments to create a dynamic and immersive experience. Whether you're a vocalist or an instrumentalist, group performances add a layer of fun and creativity to the game, perfect for adding some harmony to the chaos of the apocalypse.
IGUI_Instruments_Band_Body2: <H1> Getting Started <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Instruments_Band_02.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT> 1. Level Up Your Music Skill <LINE><TEXT> To participate in group performances, you'll need at least Music Level 4, but it's worth leveling up further. Higher levels unlock more band songs, expanding your repertoire and improving your overall performance. <H1><LINE><LEFT> 2. Develop Instrument Affinity <LINE><TEXT> Each instrument requires a certain level of familiarity, gained by learning songs for that instrument. Aim for about 20 learned songs to unlock the Group Perform option. This may sound like a lot, but at higher Music Levels, it's an easy to reach threshold. <LINE> Exception: Singing doesn't require instrument affinity, only Music Skill progression. <H1><LINE><LEFT> 3. Choose Your Role <LINE><TEXT> Each part of a band performance is tied to a specific instrument or the microphone (for vocals). While a full band with multiple instruments offers the most depth, you can perform with as few as two players. <H1><LINE><LEFT> 4. Starting the Performance <LINE><TEXT> First enter the 'Waiting Phase' by selecting the song you want to play. When in this phase, characters will just hold their instruments as if about to play, thus giving other players time to prepare. Once everyone is in the waiting phase, one player must hold the X key for a few seconds to begin the song (it's recommended that only one player hold the key down). The performance will then start, with each player contributing their selected part. <H1><LINE><LEFT> 5. Fail-Proof Fun <LINE><TEXT> Group performances are designed to be fun and frustration-free. You can't fail a song due to low skill, so even beginners can join in without worry. However, keep in mind that panic (if your character isn’t desensitized) can still disrupt the performance.
IGUI_Instruments_Band_Body3: <H1> Tips for Success <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Instruments_Band_03.png><LINE><LINE><H2><LEFT> - Build your repertoire early to have a wide selection of songs for group play. <LINE><LINE> - Coordinate with friends to assign roles and instruments before starting a session. <LINE><LINE> - Ensure your group is in a safe environment to avoid panic or interruptions during performances.
IGUI_Instruments_Band_Body4: <H2> Group performances bring a cooperative and lighthearted touch to the game, letting you and your friends create memorable moments while surviving the apocalypse!

IGUI_Inventions_FoodSynthesizer_burgerPr: A specialized shaping module compresses and paints the output into suspiciously convincing paste burgers, which are considerably more appetizing and filling than the standard paste slurry.
Synthesizes colorful paste burgers instead of simple paste.
IGUI_Inventions_FoodSynthesizer_foodCont: A larger input chamber with reinforced panels and improved feed routing allows the Food Synthesizer to hold more ingredients, allowing for more uses before requiring a refill.
IGUI_Inventions_FoodSynthesizer_foodQual: Careful calibration of the synthesis process produces a smoother, more palatable paste with better nutritional efficiency and a reduced chance of making anyone regret lunch.
Improves satiety, taste, and reduces food sickness chance.
IGUI_Inventions_FoodSynthesizer_foodUsag: Improved intake controls and tighter conversion ratios stretch every ingredient further, reducing the amount of food needed to produce each batch of paste.
IGUI_Inventions_FoodSynthesizer_multiply: An unstable but efficient duplication array occasionally overcommits during synthesis, producing double, triple, or even quadruple portions from the same cycle. Conservation of mass? You've never heard of it.
Chance to produce extra paste per cycle.
IGUI_Inventions_Harvester_booster_desc: Upgraded collectors and fine-mesh sifters increase the chance of gathering bonus seeds and surplus crops.
IGUI_Inventions_Harvester_breakDownChanc: Chance of cooling systems to fail, causing the harvester to overheat and become inoperable until it cools down.
IGUI_Inventions_Harvester_cooldownTimeMo: If harvester overheats, this is the amount of hours required until it can be operated again.
IGUI_Inventions_Harvester_power_desc: A clever rework of the intake system boosts both gobbling speed and belly room. Improved high-torque rollers accelerate collection speed while a reinforced containment bin boosts total capacity. An engineer's dream.
IGUI_Inventions_Harvester_power_desc_sho: Increases harvest speed and container capacity.
IGUI_Inventions_Harvester_replant_desc: As soon as crops are scooped up, a built-in seed flinger tosses new ones right into place with surprising effectiveness.
IGUI_Inventions_Harvester_sensors_desc: An improved sensor lattice increases environmental awareness, widening operational radius and ensuring no viable crop remains unscanned.
IGUI_Inventions_Hygienator_breakDownChan: Chance of jets failing and firing randomly, spilling dirty water around.
IGUI_Inventions_Hygienator_cooldownTimeT: Reduces the time it takes for the contraption to recharge between washes.
IGUI_Inventions_Hygienator_efficiencyTot: Overall effectiveness at hygiene and cleaning.
IGUI_Inventions_Hygienator_efficiency_de: Stronger and more efficient jets are more effective at cleaning you.
IGUI_Inventions_Hygienator_hasDryJet_des: Air jets that activate after each wash, keeping you dry... most of the time.
IGUI_Inventions_Hygienator_hasHighPressu: More powerful jets will also clean your clothes with almost zero risk of injuries.
Cleans blood and dirt from equipped clothes.
IGUI_Inventions_Hygienator_isHeated_desc: Water and electricity are combined to bring you refreshing and energizing hot water, basically jolting you awake, nevermind the shock tingles.
Swaps cold shower debuff for hot shower buff.
IGUI_Inventions_Hygienator_isPerfumed_de: Carefully placed sprayers that activate after each wash, keeping you smelling great, instead of just smelling.
Grants perfumed buff. Levels increase potency.
IGUI_Inventions_Hygienator_selfPowered_d: Thanks to clever engineering and a powerful set of batteries, the Hygienator now consumes very little power and recharges passively everytime you step on it. Effectively working off-grid.
IGUI_Inventions_Hygienator_waterUsage_de: Improved jets with better precision and controlled duration, reducing waste.
Reduces water usage and spillage chance.
IGUI_Inventions_NeuralHat_efficiency_des: Fine-tuned synaptic pruning and enhanced neurotransmitter synthesis allows a greater control over your squishy gray matter, improving processing and retention of desired information. It might occasionally delete stored memories like life events, childhood, loved ones faces and other such frivolities.
Improves overall experience gain and learning speed.
IGUI_Inventions_NeuralHat_fastRead_desc: Accelerated neural pattern matching and page-scanning algorithms allow the wearer to consume written material at double speed, at the low cost of some minor heart palpitations and sporadic eye twitching.
IGUI_Inventions_NeuralHat_overdrive_desc: Pushes neural processing past safe thresholds for a significant performance boost, but expect more frequent breakdowns and higher energy draw. Prolonged use may cause burns and some brain tingling. Probably not great for your health.
Boosts overall effectiveness, increases failure chance and battery consumption.
IGUI_Inventions_NeuralHat_safe_desc: A protective neural limiter prevents any chance of catastrophic failures by temporarily deactivating compromised neural links, with the unfortunate side-effect of locking the system out of any overclocking capabilities.
IGUI_Inventions_Panel_Costumes: Costumes costs are always fixed. <LINE> Production Time modifiers: <LINE> (+) Curio level. <LINE> (-) Inventing skill level.
IGUI_Inventions_Panel_Curios: Unlike gadgets, curios don't require any research and are fully functional right out of the box. This also means that their cost are fixed and cannot be reduced. <LINE> Production Time modifiers: <LINE> (+) Curio level. <LINE> (-) Inventing skill level.
IGUI_Inventions_Panel_Gadgets: A gadget's cost and production time increases with research. Once finished, it will contain all currently known improvements.
IGUI_Inventions_Panel_Toys: Toys costs are always fixed. <LINE> Production Time modifiers: <LINE> (+) Toy level. <LINE> (-) Inventing skill level.
IGUI_Inventions_PowerAxe_breakDownChance: Chance of weapon breaking on a power hit regardless of current condition.
Chance of exploding on the user's hands after breaking down. Use gloves to reduce the chance of injuries.
IGUI_Inventions_PowerAxe_lethal_desc: Refined impact sensors and a smarter activation circuit allow the axe to engage it's power system even against softer targets like the undead.
IGUI_Inventions_PowerAxe_lethal_desc_sho: Power hit triggers against the undead.
IGUI_Inventions_PowerAxe_power_desc: Pushes the power system beyond safe limits for increased impact force, at the cost of durability. Over-amplification may cause critical failure on impact (things go boom).
IGUI_Inventions_PowerAxe_power_desc_shor: Increases power hit damage at the cost of a higher chance to malfunction.
IGUI_Inventions_Stats_conditionLowerChan: Likelihood of weapon loosing condition on a hit.
IGUI_Inventions_breakDownChance2_desc: Chance of breaking down and other unintended consequences.
IGUI_Inventions_cooldownTimeModifier_des: Hours until machine is available again.
IGUI_Inventions_cooldownTime_desc: Improved wiring and components help reduce recharge time.
IGUI_Inventions_costDecrease_desc: Researching cheaper ways to make the same gadget will help keep costs down for future production and research.
IGUI_Inventions_costDecrease_desc_short: Reduces research time and costs, affects production slightly.
IGUI_Inventions_durability_desc: Higher-grade materials increase the lifespan of components, reducing the chance of breakdowns and malfunctions, at the cost of increased production costs.
IGUI_Inventions_durability_desc_short: Less likely to break or malfunction during use.
IGUI_Inventions_fuelConsumptionModifier_: Changes how much fuel is required to refuel this machine.
IGUI_Inventions_fuelConsumption_desc: Upgraded injectors and optimized flow control reduce overall fuel consumption per use, reducing waste during refueling and improving operational efficiency.
IGUI_Inventions_fuelContainerModifier_de: Total available uses when completely full.
IGUI_Inventions_fuelContainer_desc: A redesigned fuel container with improved sealing and reinforced structure allows for greater fuel capacity, but it may make the gadget heavier.
IGUI_Inventions_fuelUsesModifier_desc: Average number of uses available before running out of fuel.
IGUI_Inventions_noPlumbing_desc: Somehow this machine is able to absorb ground water and atmospheric vapor during it's recharging time. It no longer requires plumbing.
IGUI_Inventions_productionModifier_desc: Making and repairing gadgets become more costly the more improvements they have. Invest in cost decreasing research to improve this modifier.
IGUI_Inventions_recirculator_desc: A clever system of return valves and micro-filters captures unburnt fuel vapor and routes it back into the tank, giving your machine a chance to operate without spending a drop. Miraculously efficient.
IGUI_Inventions_recirculator_desc_short: Adds a chance to not spend fuel on use.
IGUI_Inventions_repairPenalty_desc: Repairing is cheaper than making machines from scratch, but can still get expensive without cost decreasing research.
IGUI_Inventions_researchModifier_desc: Researching quickly becomes more costly with each new research. Invest in cost decreasing research to improve this modifier.
IGUI_Inventions_resistantModifier_desc: Decreases the chance for weapon condition loss on hit.
IGUI_Inventions_resistant_desc: Upgraded joints and reinforced casing minimize internal stress from repeated impacts, decreasing the chance of wear when hitting stuff.
IGUI_Inventions_resistant_desc_short: Less likely to lose condition on hit.
IGUI_Inventions_selfPowered_desc: A compact self-sustaining power setup keeps the machine going off the grid, on the grid, and occasionally in spite of the grid.
IGUI_Inventions_silent_desc: A clever assortment of mufflers, padding, and vibration reducers tones down the gadget's operational noise. Cuts sound output and keeps nearby zombies blissfully unaware of your mechanical mischief.
IGUI_Inventions_silent_desc_short: Muffles your gadget's sound and reduces zombie attraction range.
IGUI_Inventions_standardization_desc: Working with standard dimensions and modular pieces can greatly reduce the time and cost it takes to make and repair your machines.
IGUI_Inventions_standardization_desc_sho: Reduces production and repair time and costs.
IGUI_Inventions_weightDecrease_desc: A combination of lighter plates, trimmed wiring and reinforced ultra-light components cut down the heft, making your gadget easier to lug around.
IGUI_Inventions_weightTotalModifier_desc: Improvements impact on this gadget's base encumbrance.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_Debug_Warning: Confirm to apply changes, this will reset progress for all players attempting this ambition
IGUI_LSAmbitions_Debug_Warning3: Attention: returning to default values will always reset progress for all players!
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSBladeMaster_desc: While others led a carefree life, you studied the blade. After practicing with bladed weapons for a long time, they strike faster and deal more damage with bladed weaponry in combat.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSBladeMaster_footer: Points must be gained while ambition is active.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSBladeMaster_give: +15% bladed weapon damage and swing speed.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSBladeMaster_givePassi: Bladed weapons take longer to break.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSBrushmaster_Appraise: After thoughtful evaluation, you believe this artwork has the potential to become...
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSBrushmaster_desc: Brushmasters have honed their craft and, with a flick of the wrist, they can whip up paintings in record time. As true connoisseurs of the arts, they have the uncanny ability to know if a new piece is going to turn out as something meh or magnificent long before the final result.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSBrushmaster_give: New paintings are completed at a much faster rate.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSBrushmaster_givePassi: Can guess an artwork's final quality. Precision depends on completion percentage.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSCommando_desc: Commandos are pure raw no-nonsense unstoppable forces on the battlefield. Their skill with rifles and heavier firearms is unmatched, however, their brutish method lacks the finesse required to handle stealthier approaches.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSCommando_footer: Count resets when Ambition is deactivated.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSCommando_give: +5% damage, less recoil and increased aiming speed with shotguns and rifles.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSDietOfGods_desc: Not a mere foodie, you are a true connoisseur of the end-of-the-world cuisine. The hardship of procuring only the juiciest of foods to please your hungry palate has given you an appreciation few seem to have for the lost gourmand arts, allowing you to feel satiated for much longer.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSDietOfGods_footer: Fulfilling: food eaten whole when hungry, making you full to bursting
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSDietOfGods_give: Full to Bursting moodle (and bonuses) stays for much longer.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSDietOfGods_req: Eat a fulfilling food when peckish or worse
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSDietOfGods_tip: A true gourmand loves hearty food, especially when on an empty stomach.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSElDorado_desc: Wealth has lost its value, but the allure of gold still captivates you. Despite the end of civilization, you’re driven to amass riches, unwilling to abandon the shine of wealth even when it serves no purpose. Even if it spells your death, you couldn't let it go.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSElDorado_footer: Demand for wealth decreases when ambition is deactivated.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSElDorado_give: Periodically consumes money and jewelry for increased damage, with rising stress if you lack enough wealth.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSElDorado_givePassive: Small chance to find money on zombies. Affected by Lucky and Unlucky traits.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSElDorado_unit1: Gold Bars picked up at least once
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSElDorado_unit2: Gold Jewelry held in your inventory at least once
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSElDorado_unit3: Paper money held in your inventory at least once
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSExplorer_desc: The Kentucky Explorer has ventured far and wide, uncovering unique points of interest all across Kentucky, from forgotten cabins to questionable gas stations and mysterious roadside attractions.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSExplorer_give: Reveals the whole map while active
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSExplorer_givePassive: Increased chance for zombies to drop maps, including annotated maps.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSGoodEating_desc: Oh delicious succulent meat! You've developed a taste for the wild side.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSGoodEating_footer: New friends living in your gut!
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSGoodEating_give: Food poisoning immunity, low poison resistance.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSGoodEating_givePassiv: Small chance to get 'blood sausages' from kills.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSGoodEating_req: Stay very hungry or worse for 24 hours straight
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSGoodEating_tip: Taste is housed in parts of the mind that precede pity, and pity has no place at the dinner table.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSGrimeFighter_desc: Grimefighters have scrubbed, mopped, and swept their way through thousands of messes, earning their place as the ultimate champions of cleanliness. They can clean up any disaster twice as fast. To aid in their fight they have the 'EzyCl33n Utili-Tool', which can be used once a day to sanitize an entire area with one heroic sweep, banishing even the most villainous stains to the dustbin of history.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSGrimeFighter_footer: Count resets when Ambition is deactivated.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSGrimeFighter_give: Once per day can access the 'EzyCl33n Utili-Tool' to clean an entire area instantly.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSGrimeFighter_givePass: All cleaning actions are performed twice as fast.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSGrimeFighter_tip: With great cleaning power comes great responsibility.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSJuryRigger_desc: After patching up hundreds of weapons and vehicle parts with duct tape, chewing gum and a good kick or two, Jury Riggers have become the ultimate masters of redneck technology, their work is so effective that items not only last longer but sometimes even work better than before. How does it work? Nobody knows... except you!
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSJuryRigger_footer: Repair count resets when Ambition is deactivated.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSJuryRigger_give: For every two repairs on an item performed by you, the second will not count toward its total number of repairs.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSJuryRigger_givePassiv: The first repair on a new weapon will never count toward its total number of repairs.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSJuryRigger_tip: The duct tape whispers its secrets only to seasoned hands.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSKnockdown_desc: Some folks talk things out, but why waste words when a well-placed swing makes your point loud and clear? You settle arguments with blunt force diplomacy.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSKnockdown_give: +30% knockdown chance and increased damage when using baseball bats.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSKnockdown_givePassive: All melee hits and unarmed shoves have a greater chance to stagger or knock down enemies. +5% for unarmed and one-handed weapons, +15% for two-handed weapons.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSLordDeath_desc: Kill kill kill. What you kill makes you stronger. Drink from your enemies' skulls and leave only devastation in your wake - with every swing, you unleash unparalleled force, cleaving trough the undead and the living, ensuring nothing left standing stays that way for long.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSLordDeath_give: +2.5% damage (up to +30%), increased per recent kill, and +10% swing speed when using two-handed weapons (not spears).
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSLordDeath_givePassive: Very small boost to endurance recovery rate while wielding two-handed weapons, increased by kills when active.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSLordDeath_tip: Only when both muscle and mastery are sharpened to perfection may Death itself choose you as its herald.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSLucky_desc: Some call it luck, others call it fate, but Four-Leaf Finders have beaten the odds by receiving several good fortunes in a row from a wildly unreliable fortune-telling machine. Their uncanny streak of good luck grants them a permanent boost to finding good loot, winning games of chance, and avoiding unfortunate accidents.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSLucky_footer: Bad outcomes will reset the counting.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSLucky_give: Adds trait: Lucky. Removes trait: Unlucky.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSLucky_req: Find or create a fortune-teller machine and use it.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSLucky_tip: Have your future read by a malfunctioning machine.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSLucky_unit1: Good Outcomes Streak (from having your fortune read)
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSLumberjack_desc: You've got beef with the forest, and your axe is your therapist. Every swing settles a score with nature - and by now, you know exactly how to make any tree fall right.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSLumberjack_give: Increased tree chopping speed. Chance to get additional logs.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSLumberjack_givePassiv: Reduced fatigue from chopping trees. Axes degrade more slowly when used for tree cutting.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSMasterPainter_desc: Master Painters have created several masterpieces, elevating their artistic talents to legendary status. Their brush strokes are imbued with creativity and precision, giving them a significantly higher chance of painting masterpieces.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSMasterPainter_give: New paintings have a much higher chance to be masterpieces.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSPlushies_desc: You used to think plushies were just cute. Harmless. But they talk to you now, whisper secrets, plot things. With your beady-eyed critter friends, you'll never be alone again.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSPlushies_footer: The plushies whisper to you now.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSPlushies_give: A steady trickle of happiness while carrying plushies, increased by variety.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSPlushies_givePassive: Interacting with plushies give a much higher boost to happiness.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSPlushies_unit3: Jacques The Beaver & Fluffyfoot The Bunny
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSPlushies_unit4: Freddy The Fox & Pancake The Hedgehog
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSPlushies_unit5: Moley The Mole & Furbert The Squirrel
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSRockstar_desc: After mastering their craft and learning dozens of masterful songs, Rockstars are granted unrivaled stage presence - the show must go on!
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSRockstar_footer: Ambition must be active. Songs learned from Music Notebooks don't count.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSRockstar_give: Playing music gives triple the usual bonuses.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSRockstar_givePassive: Unlock new masterful songs for guitars.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSTerminator_desc: A Terminator has eliminated thousands of zombies while ignoring any pain or exhaustion, proving themselves as the ultimate killing machine. Their strong will and combat skills allows them to dispatch foes with unmatched efficiency, taking less damage and recovering from exhaustion faster.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSTerminator_footer: Kill count resets when Ambition is deactivated.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSTerminator_give: Higher endurance recovery rate, very small chance to ignore damage, stronger fire resistance.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSTerminator_goal2: While In Progress: force High Exertion
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSTheProfessional_desc: The Professional has taken out several targets using only handguns and stealth, mastering the art of silent, efficient elimination. Their refined techniques grant them improved efficiency when striking from the shadows. This meticulous approach is incompatible with other more loud-and-proud styles.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSTheProfessional_foote: Count resets when Ambition is deactivated.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSTheProfessional_give: Bonus to reload speed, crit chance and +25% stealth damage with handguns.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSUnstoppable_desc: You have survived over hundreds serious injuries, emerging tougher (and probably a bit crazier) each time. Repeatedly taking injuries has led your body to become more resilient (somehow).
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSUnstoppable_footer: Count resets when Ambition is deactivated.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSUnstoppable_give: Very small chance to completely heal a single body part once per day, except for knox infection.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSWanderer_desc: All that walking has turned you into a lean, mean, terrain-crossing machine. You've walked farther than most will ever dare. Roads, ruins and wilderness - none of it slows you down anymore. Your feet are calloused, your stride unshaken.
IGUI_LSAmbitions_LSWanderer_givePassive: Permanent increase to carry capacity. Adds trait: Outdoorsman.
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Awful_NoteText: Ew... Looks like a toddler first attempt at art. And not a very talented toddler.
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Awful_NoteText_Alt: People say art is subjective, but somehow you've managed to make objectively BAD art... good job?
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Excellent_NoteText: Now THIS could be in a gallery. Incredible work!
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Excellent_NoteText_: This artwork could make someone question their life choices - in a good way.
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Good_NoteText: You've captured something here! You're not sure what, but it looks nice.
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Good_NoteText_Alt: It's nice enough that you wouldn't mind framing it... for the bathroom.
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Impressive_NoteText: Great work! This piece commands attention.
This piece practically whispers: 'Look at me, I'm fancy!'
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Masterpiece_NoteTex: Congratulations! You've created a legendary piece of art!
A Masterpiece! This is beyond art, it's the stuff of legends. Raiders will be fighting over this one!
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Normal_NoteText: Well done! It's a perfectly respectable piece of art, just don't stare too long.
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Normal_NoteText_Alt: An admirable effort! Just the right mix of 'meh' and 'okay'.
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Poor_NoteText: Well, it's... something. Perfect for the back of a closet.
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Poor_NoteText_Alt: It's like the artwork *tried*, but then it gave up halfway through.
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Shoddy_NoteText: Art critics might call this 'raw'. Regular folks might call it 'rough'.
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Shoddy_NoteText_Alt: Someone might call it 'rustic', if they're feeling generous.
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Wondrous_NoteText: Majestic! This is the kind of art that sparks joy, tears, or heated philosophical debates.
IGUI_PaintingQuality_Wondrous_NoteText_A: Wonderful! This is the kind of art that people pretend to understand to look smart.
IGUI_T_Ambt_Body: Ambitions represent your character's personal goals and long-term desires during the apocalypse. Rather than focusing solely on survival, Ambitions give your survivor something to strive for, whether it's exploring Kentucky, mastering a skill, performing great combat feats or collecting rare items. Once active, progress is tracked automatically as you play, and completing these objectives can provide unique benefits to your character.
IGUI_T_Ambt_Body2: <H1> Picking Ambitions <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Ambt_02.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Open the pie menu ( <ORANGE> default hotkey: Q <TEXT> ) and select the  <ORANGE> Ambitions <TEXT> option (big Spiffo icon) to view all available ambitions. <LINE><LINE> Here you will find detailed <ORANGE>  descriptions, goals and rewards <TEXT> for every ambition. <LINE><LINE><H2> How to Activate <LINE><TEXT> - Most ambitions are available right from the start of the game and appear on the upper-right side of the menu. <LINE> - Click an ambition to expand its details. <LINE> - To activate, click the <ORANGE>  moon icon <TEXT>  on the left or simply double-click the ambition. A confirmation window will appear. <LINE><LINE> Once confirmed, the ambition is chosen and progress will be tracked automatically. <LINE><LINE><H2> Important Notes <LINE><TEXT> - Some ambitions carry <ORANGE> conditions or debuffs <TEXT>  until they are completed or deactivated. <LINE> - To deactivate, click the <ORANGE>  light bulb icon <TEXT> or double-click the ambition. <LINE> - A cooldown prevents immediate deactivation; hover over the light bulb icon to see remaining time. <LINE> - Most ambitions reset progress when deactivated. <LINE> - Completed ambitions can be toggled on/off at will without losing completion. <LINE><LINE> Remember: you can only have a <ORANGE>  limited number <TEXT> of ambitions active at the same time. Choose wisely!
IGUI_T_Ambt_Body3: <H1> Types of Ambitions <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Ambt_03.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Ambitions can exist in several states: <LINE><LINE><ORANGE> - Inactive: <TEXT>  Default state. They appear in the list but are not being pursued. <LINE> - Can be activated if under the ambition limit. <LINE> - Completed ambitions still grant their <ORANGE>  passive bonuses <TEXT>, even when inactive. <LINE><LINE><ORANGE> - Active: <TEXT>  Ambitions currently being pursued. <LINE> - Progress is tracked automatically. <LINE> - Completed ambitions grant all their bonuses while active. <LINE><LINE><ORANGE> - Passive: <TEXT>  These ambitions don’t require activation to progress. <LINE> - Once completed, they must be activated to grant any <ORANGE> active <TEXT>  bonuses. <LINE><LINE><ORANGE> - Hidden: <TEXT>  Locked ambitions. They remain invisible until certain <ORANGE>  secret conditions <TEXT>  are fulfilled.
IGUI_T_Ambt_Body4: <H1> Bonuses <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Ambt_04.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Each ambition has a <ORANGE>  chain of milestones <TEXT>  that must be completed. Fulfilling all milestones will unlock its rewards: <LINE><LINE><ORANGE> - Passive bonuses: <TEXT>  Permanent and always active once unlocked. <LINE><ORANGE> - Active bonuses: <TEXT>  Granted only while the ambition is active. <LINE><LINE> Completed ambitions can be deactivated and reactivated freely without losing progress, though cooldowns still apply.
IGUI_T_Ambt_Body5: <H1> Removing Ambitions <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Ambt_05.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> You can abandon any ambition mid-progress. <LINE><LINE> - Removing an ambition triggers a <ORANGE>  cooldown <TEXT>, preventing you from re-selecting it for several in-game hours. <LINE> - Most ambitions will reset progress if disabled before completion. <LINE><LINE><H2> How to Remove <LINE><TEXT> - Open the ambitions menu. <LINE> - Double-click the ambition you want to deactivate, or click the <ORANGE>  light bulb icon <TEXT>. <LINE><LINE> You cannot deactivate an ambition if it was activated very recently. You must wait for the cooldown to finish first.
IGUI_T_Ambt_Body6: <H1> Customization <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Ambt_06.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> The ambition system can be customized in multiple ways: <LINE><LINE><ORANGE> - Lifestyle Debug Options: <TEXT>  Reset or disable individual ambitions and edit their goals. <LINE><ORANGE> - Custom Ambitions: <TEXT>  Add your own by inserting new entries into the ambition table inside <ORANGE> LSAmbitions.lua <TEXT> . <LINE><ORANGE> - Sandbox Options: <TEXT>  Adjust global settings for how ambitions behave.
IGUI_T_Ambt_Note: Ambitions are long-term goals designed to help shape your character's journey. Click the '?' button to learn more.
IGUI_T_Art_Easel_Body: Artworks allow you to transform your character's environment into a haven of beauty and creativity. By creating stunning art, you can enhance the beauty score of your surroundings, directly influencing your character's mood. Whether it's through delicate brushstrokes on a canvas or chiseling intricate details into a sculpture, this mechanic provides an immersive way to express artistry and improve your home.
IGUI_T_Art_Easel_Body2: <H1> Enhancing Beauty with Artworks <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Painting_02.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Most furniture and decorative items can affect your character's beauty score, either positively or negatively. Artworks are among the most effective ways to maintain a high beauty score, contributing significantly to your environment's aesthetic appeal. Artworks can be created using: <LINE><LINE> - Easels, for paintings. <LINE> Sculpting Stations, for sculptures. <LINE><LINE> The quality and impact of these artworks largely depend on your character's Art skill. <H1><LINE><LEFT> Getting Started with Painting <LINE><TEXT> To begin painting, gather the necessary tools and supplies: <LINE> 1. Tools: An artist's paintbrush and a painting palette. <LINE> 2. Supplies: Art supplies to keep your palette filled. <LINE><LINE> Once your palette is filled and you have the tools, interact with an easel to start painting. A few noteworthy details: <LINE> - Small canvases are available initially for practice. <LINE> - Higher Art skill levels unlock larger canvases and better painting options. <LINE> - At Art skill level 2, you transition from practice to creating refined works. <LINE> - A Paint (Simple) option becomes available at higher skill levels, enabling your character to work on quick, less complex pieces from earlier skill levels. <LINE> - You can store multiple painting palettes in your inventory, and your character will automatically use a new one when the current palette runs out. <H1><LINE><LEFT> Sculpting Essentials <LINE><TEXT> Sculpting is a more advanced artistic pursuit requiring: <LINE> - 1. A variety of tools specific to the type of sculpture (e.g., hammers, blowtorches). <LINE> - 2. Materials such as planks, scrap, stones, depending on your project. <LINE><LINE> The sculpting option tooltip will display the exact requirements for each piece. Sculptures demand a higher initial Art skill level than paintings and sometimes require proficiency in other skills. For example: <LINE> - Hedge/Topiary: Unlocks at Art skill level 4. <LINE> - Metal Sculptures: Requires skill levels in Art and Metalworking.
IGUI_T_Art_Easel_Body3: <H1> The Creative Process <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Painting_03.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Artworks take time to complete, the more intricate the piece the longer it will take to complete it. However, progress is saved, allowing you to work on your art across multiple sessions. Take breaks as needed to refill supplies like painting palettes or blowtorches. Once an artwork is finished, a summary window will appear, offering the following options: <LINE><LINE> - Rename the artwork and add a description (this cannot be changed later). <LINE> - Review details such as quality, beauty value, style, and the creator's name. <LINE><LINE> Quality is determined by factors such as: <LINE> - Art skill level. <LINE> - Complexity and size of the artwork. <LINE> - The artist's mood during creation. <LINE><LINE> Beauty Value: This is influenced by the quality, size, and complexity of the piece. Finished artworks can be placed in the world to boost the beauty score of your surroundings. Paintings can also be enhanced with frames, which can be swapped out at any time without affecting beauty value. Some sculptures may even have hidden functionalities.
IGUI_T_Art_Easel_Body4: <H1> Tips for Progression <LINE><LINE><H2><LEFT> - Small canvases can be used to practice and gain experience quickly. <LINE><LINE> - Completing an artwork provides a larger XP reward, helping you level up faster. <LINE><LINE> - Sculpting becomes accessible at higher skill levels and unlocks more options as you progress. <LINE><LINE> - Be cautious when placing sculptures, as they can be destroyed by zombies if blocking paths. <LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> The painting and sculpting mechanic offers a rewarding way to beautify your environment and showcase your artistic skills. Whether you're starting with simple paintings or crafting intricate sculptures, every artwork adds character and charm to your surroundings. As you refine your Art skill, you'll unlock new possibilities, allowing you to leave a lasting mark on the world. Embrace your creativity and watch your artistic vision come to life!
IGUI_T_Art_Easel_Note: Artworks are an excellent way to enhance your character's mood by beautifying their surroundings. Click the '?' button to learn more.
IGUI_T_Beauty_Body: Beauty is a fundamental need that shapes your character's emotional wellbeing. A visually pleasing environment provides comfort and happiness, while neglected spaces can lead to stress and dissatisfaction. This system tracks how surroundings affect your character's psyche, with effects that develop gradually based on exposure to beautiful or unpleasant environments.
IGUI_T_Beauty_Body2: <H1> Beauty Scores <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Beauty_02.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Every environment has a beauty score calculated from its visual elements: <LINE><LINE> - Positive Contributors: Clean spaces, artworks, quality furniture, decor and attractive flooring <LINE> - Negative Factors: Dirt, grime, cracks, graffiti, bloodstains, trash, broken glass, ugly furniture, etc. <LINE><LINE> Hover over the beauty score indicator (bottom-right UI) or beauty moodle to see the current area's score. The higher the absolute value (positive or negative), the faster it affects your character's beauty need.
IGUI_T_Beauty_Body3: <H1> Beauty Need Mechanics <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Beauty_03.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Beauty need changes gradually as your character spends time in different environments: <LINE><LINE> - Negative effects only occur indoors - ugly outdoor spaces won't cause distress <LINE> - Being outdoors slowly resets negative beauty need to neutral and will improve it to positive levels if the area is beautiful <LINE><LINE> New characters enjoy a grace period (configurable in sandbox) before being affected by ugly environments, lasting from days to months.
IGUI_T_Beauty_Body4: <H1> Improving Your Environment <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Beauty_04.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Several actions can enhance an area's beauty score: <LINE><LINE> - Cleaning surfaces and removing trash <LINE> - Placing quality furniture and decorations <LINE> - Displaying artworks (most effective) <LINE> - Repairing damaged walls and floors <LINE><LINE> Remember that beauty perception is tile-based - focus improvements where your character spends most of their time.
IGUI_T_Beauty_Body5: <H1> Trait Modifiers <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Beauty_05.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Character traits can significantly alter beauty perception: <LINE><LINE> - Sloppy: Less affected by dirt and mess <LINE> - Neat Freak: More sensitive to unclean environments <LINE> - Artistic: Gains extra benefits from artworks <LINE> - Hates Art: Actually distressed by art and some types of decoration <LINE><LINE> These traits create meaningful differences in how characters experience and maintain their spaces. Beauty scores will reflect that difference, thus allowing you to know at all times exactly what surrounding tiles are bothering your character.
IGUI_T_Beauty_Body6: <H1> Sandbox Options <LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> The beauty system can be tailored to your preferences: <LINE><LINE> - Adjust grace period duration <LINE> - Modify outdoor effects <LINE> - Change beauty need decay rate <LINE> - Disable negative beauty scores from trash, bloodstains and grime <LINE> - Disable beauty scores from artworks <LINE> - Disable entirely for minimalist gameplay by disabling Cleaning and Art <LINE><LINE> By understanding and managing beauty needs, you can create spaces that are both functional and uplifting, contributing to your character's overall wellbeing and satisfaction.
IGUI_T_Dancing_Body: Dancing is a dynamic way for characters to express themselves, socialize and stay fit, all while vibing to their favorite tunes. Whether they're busting moves solo or throwing an epic party, dancing improves skills, boosts mood, and even unlocks special interactions. But beware: fatigue, embarrassment, and clumsy missteps can turn a dancefloor hero into a wallflower!
IGUI_T_Dancing_Body2: <H1> The Basics of Dancing <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Dancing_02.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> To start dancing, your character must be near an active music source like a jukebox or DJ booth. Certain conditions prevent dancing: <LINE><LINE> - Wearing noise-canceling gear like earmuffs or ear protectors <LINE> - Currently sneaking <LINE> - Extreme exhaustion or high embarrassment levels <LINE><LINE> As your character dances, they'll naturally improve their Dancing skill and overall Fitness. The moves they perform adapt to both the music genre and their current skill level - beginners start with simple steps while experts can perform complex routines. Higher skill levels provide greater mood benefits and allow for longer dancing sessions before tiring.
IGUI_T_Dancing_Body3: <H1> Leveling Up <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Dancing_03.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Several methods can improve your Dancing skill: <LINE><LINE> - Regular practice on the dance floor <LINE> - Studying dance instruction books <LINE> - Watching Dancing Lesson VHS tapes (three progressive levels available) <LINE> - Participating in or hosting parties <LINE><LINE> Parties offer the most significant skill growth opportunities when properly organized. <H1><LINE><LEFT> Don't trip over your own feet! <LINE><TEXT> Dancing is physically demanding and comes with several considerations: <LINE><LINE> - Body heat increases during dancing <LINE> - Exhaustion builds up over time <LINE> - Low skill or fatigue increases mistake chances <LINE><LINE> Mistakes range from minor fumbles (adding slight embarrassment) to critical failures where the character falls prone in humiliation. Beginners may also experience muscle soreness after extended dancing, temporarily reducing movement speed and combat effectiveness.
IGUI_T_Dancing_Body4: <H1> Party System Mechanics <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Dancing_04.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Parties operate on a hidden scoring system that determines their quality and benefits: <LINE><LINE> - More dancers increase the score, especially if dancing close together <LINE> - DJs with high Music skill <LINE> - Lacking a DJ, using the jukebox to play your character's favorite genre <LINE> - Disco floors and disco balls <LINE><LINE> The party's mood is represented by four stages, each providing increasing bonuses to XP gain and mood improvements from dancing. Even non-dancing guests contribute to the party score, though active participants provide greater benefits.
IGUI_T_Dancing_Body5: <H1> Traits and Crafting <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Dancing_05.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Certain traits significantly impact dancing ability: <LINE><LINE> - Clumsy: Increased mistake frequency <LINE> - Party Animal: Bonus XP and enhanced enjoyment from parties <LINE> - Party Pooper: Cannot benefit from party XP boosts <LINE><LINE> After reading HomeStyle: DISCO Special Edition magazine, characters can craft special dancing equipment: <LINE><LINE> - Disco Floors: Create dazzling light shows synchronized to music <LINE> - Disco Balls: Illuminate large areas with dynamic light patterns <LINE> - DJ Booths: Professional 3-tile setups for skilled musicians to control music and lighting <LINE><LINE> These items can transform any space into a vibrant dance venue.
IGUI_T_Dancing_Body6: <H1> Sandbox Options <LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> The dancing system can be customized through sandbox settings, allowing you to: <LINE><LINE> - Adjust experience and mood gain rates <LINE> - Enable or disable the activity <LINE><LINE> Dancing offers a unique way to develop your character's personality and social connections while providing tangible gameplay benefits. Characters can groove to nearby music, express themselves through dynamic moves, and even throw unforgettable parties.
IGUI_T_Dancing_Note: Whether you're grooving solo or with friends, dancing is a great activity for your mind, body, and soul! Click the '?' button to learn more.
IGUI_T_Yoga_Body: Yoga is a holistic fitness and wellness activity designed to reduce physical pain, accelerate muscle recovery and cultivate mental clarity. It blends simple movement, focus, and breathing into a calm, empowering practice. Easily done in safe spaces during quiet moments, yoga can become a vital tool in maintaining both body and mind throughout the apocalypse.
IGUI_T_Yoga_Body2: <H1> Getting Started <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Yoga_02.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Yoga can be performed anywhere safe, as long as your character is not exhausted or highly embarrassed. <LINE><LINE> - Each session is made up of a series of poses, starting with simple ones and expanding as your skill increases. <LINE> - Each pose helps reduce pain and strain, while also granting experience in the hidden Yoga skill. <LINE><LINE> Starting out, only a few poses will be available and only a few can be performed per session.
IGUI_T_Yoga_Body3: <H1> The Yoga Skill <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Yoga_03.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Yoga is a hidden skill that levels up through use. The more you practice, the more benefits you'll gain: <LINE><LINE> - Unlock new and more complex poses <LINE> - Perform more poses in a single session <LINE> - Increase XP gain and pose effectiveness <LINE> - Reduce failure chance during complex poses <LINE><LINE> Skill progresses like any normal skill, from Level 0 (Beginner) to Level 10 (Mastery). Failing poses becomes increasingly rare as you improve the skill and impossible once mastered.
IGUI_T_Yoga_Body4: <H1> Yoga Sessions <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Yoga_04.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Each session consists of poses selected from those your character has available at their skill level. Poses are performed one after another until the session limit is reached or the character fails. <LINE><LINE> - XP is granted per completed pose, with harder poses giving more experience <LINE> - Benefits include pain reduction, stress relief, and muscle strain recovery <LINE> - Some advanced poses automatically trigger earlier ones, allowing more poses to be done in the same session <LINE><LINE> If the character fails a pose, they fall, suffer some minor embarrassment, and skip directly to the final pose: Shavasana.
IGUI_T_Yoga_Body5: <H1> The Shavasana Pose <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Yoga_05.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Shavasana is the final and essential relaxation pose in every yoga session: <LINE><LINE> - Grants bonus XP based on the number of poses completed <LINE> - Triggers the  <ORANGE>  Zen  <TEXT>  moodle if Yoga level is at 1 or higher <LINE> - Zen temporarily boosts XP gain for Fitness and Strength exercises, Meditation and Yoga <LINE> - Higher Yoga levels extend Zen duration and enhance its effects <LINE><LINE> Skipping Shavasana denies any XP bonus and will even remove some XP as penalty. Always try to finish your session properly.
IGUI_T_Yoga_Body6: <H1> Failure and Embarrassment <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Yoga_06.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Some complex poses may fail, especially at low skill levels. Failure leads to: <LINE><LINE> - Character falls and skips remaining poses <LINE> - Increase to embarrassment levels <LINE> - Immediate transition to Shavasana (without XP loss unless skipped) <LINE><LINE> Caution: High embarrassment will prevent starting another yoga session until it subsides.
IGUI_T_Yoga_Body7: <H1> Enhancing Your Practice <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Yoga_07.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Yoga's effectiveness can be enhanced with certain objects: <LINE><LINE> -  <ORANGE>  Yoga Mats <TEXT> : Rectangular bathroom rugs can be used as yoga mats, increasing XP gain and strengthening yoga and Zen benefits <LINE> -  <ORANGE>  Incense <TEXT> : Created at the invention workbench, burning incense further boosts effects when active nearby
IGUI_T_Yoga_Body8: <H1> Interrupting Sessions <LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> You can stop yoga sessions at any time by moving or aiming, but doing so comes at a cost: <LINE><LINE> - Penalty to XP, reduced depending on how many poses were left (Shavasana included) <LINE> - This may reduce current XP, but never decreases your skill level <LINE> - Avoid stopping early unless necessary <LINE> - Yoga can be stopped early without penalties if done before any pose was completed <LINE> - Try to finish your routine and end with Shavasana for maximum rewards
IGUI_T_Yoga_Body9: <H1> Sandbox Options <LINE><LINE><LEFT><TEXT> Yoga can be customized through sandbox settings: <LINE><LINE> - Adjust Yoga XP gain rate and effects strength <LINE> - Change embarrassment and exhaustion thresholds <LINE> - Enable/Disable mat and incense bonuses <LINE> - Tweak pose fail rate <LINE><LINE> With patience and routine, yoga can become a central pillar of survival, restoring the body and easing the mind.
IGUI_T_Yoga_Note: Yoga helps reduce muscle pain while boosting fitness and strength xp gain. Click the '?' button to learn more.
IGUI_Teller_Bad1: The robot beeped ominously and declared: 'your future is cloudy... like the inside of a dumpster.'
IGUI_Teller_Bad2: The fortune was cut off by a spark, but you're pretty sure it said something about impending doom.
IGUI_Teller_Bad3: Apparently, 'you will trip over greatness' wasn't a metaphor. Watch your step.

IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillAiming_1: Control your breathing. Squeeze the trigger, don't pull it. And focus on the front sight — everything else blurs, and that's fine.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillAiming_2: Training. Muscle memory kicks in when your brain shuts down from fear. Dry fire every night if you can — repetition is everything.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillAiming_3: Panicking and shooting fast. You'll miss and waste ammo. Slow down, aim, and make the shot count. Ammo is survival.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCarpentry_1: Always measure twice, cut once. And keep your tools sharp — a dull saw is dangerous and sloppy.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCarpentry_2: Solid joints make solid structures. Learn to nail and screw properly and you can build almost anything.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCarpentry_3: Double up the walls, brace the corners, and always build on a proper foundation. Shortcuts get people killed.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCooking_1: You'd be surprised what you can do with canned goods and a fire. Season everything, and never waste fat — it adds flavor and calories.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCooking_2: Smell it, look at it. If it smells off or has mold, toss it. When in doubt, cook it — heat kills most things.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCooking_3: Stews. One pot, water, and whatever you find. Boil it long enough and almost anything becomes edible.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillElectrical_1: Generators are your best bet. Keep the fuel fresh, don't overload it, and run it away from where people sleep — carbon monoxide kills silently.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillElectrical_2: Never touch anything live. Always cut power first. Circuit breakers exist for a reason — if one trips repeatedly, something is wrong upstream.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillElectrical_3: Match wire gauges, secure all connections, and insulate everything. Bad insulation causes fires. Fires out here are a death sentence.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFarming_1: Good soil, water, sunlight, and patience. Raised beds help — they drain better and keep pests away from the roots.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFarming_2: Potatoes and beans. They grow fast, don't need much, and give you calories. Tomatoes too, if you have seeds.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFarming_3: Rotate your crops and keep the area clean. Companion planting helps too — some plants keep bugs away from others naturally.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFirstAid_1: Clean it immediately, always. Pressure stops bleeding. Without antibiotics, infection is what actually kills you — watch for redness and fever.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFirstAid_2: Antiseptic and bandages. Everything else is secondary. A clean wound that's wrapped properly heals. A dirty one doesn't.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFirstAid_3: Splint it — any straight, rigid material works. Tie it in place, immobilize the joint, don't let them walk on it. And pray.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillMechanics_1: Check your fluids first — oil, coolant, brake fluid. If it runs, listen for what sounds wrong. Engines talk if you let them.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillMechanics_2: Tire changes and battery swaps. After that, belts and filters. Simple stuff keeps a car alive longer than anything.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillMechanics_3: Smoke, knocking, seized parts — those are signs it's gone. Otherwise, most things are fixable if you have time and parts.

IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_FightingForFood: Not having to fight for every meal.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_HadToStopHoping: I did at first. After a while... you have to stop hoping.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_HatedAdmit: I hate to admit it, but yes... and now none of it matters.

IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_HumansWorseThan: Many times. Humans can be far worse.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_JokeSurprised: Ha! You're funnier than you look.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_KeepGoingAnyway: Sometimes. But I keep going anyway... habit, I guess.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_KeepMoving: Hope is a luxury... but it's what keeps me moving.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_LearnedShooting: I guess I learned to shoot... on the fly.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_LookWhereItLed: Yes... and look where it got me.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_LosingMindBecom: Losing my mind and becoming one of them.

IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_MakesEverything: Tell me about it. Makes everything harder.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_MathBook: Why did the math book kill itself?
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_NeverReachUs: If it exists, it'll never reach us.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_NeverSawAgain: Yes... and I never saw him again.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_NiceToSeeYou: Likewise... always good to see a familiar face.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_NoSafePlace: A safe place? That doesn't exist anymore.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_NotGreat: Not so good, but I'll be okay.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Poker: I used to play poker... now I gamble with luck.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_ProbablyNot: Probably not. I wasn't that important to anyone.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_RepeatCycle: Wake up, hunt, try not to die... repeat.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_SameOldApocalyp: Nah. Same old end of the world.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_SilenceMeansWro: The silence... it usually means something's wrong.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_SleepingSafe: Sleeping without fear of not waking up.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_SmallApartment: In a cramped apartment... I even miss it now.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_SmallTownQuiet: Small town. Nothing special. I used to hate how quiet it was... I miss that now.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_SonPeterOutTher: My son Peter is out there somewhere... the others... well, you know.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_SorryForNotBein: I'd say I'm sorry for not being there when it mattered.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_StaySharpFog: Fog means you can't see them coming. Stay sharp.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Story_Chickens: My neighbor kept chickens before all this. We all thought he was crazy. Now I'd do anything for a fresh egg.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Story_Concert: I was at a concert when the outbreak news came to everyone's phones. People just... kept dancing. Nobody believed it yet. I miss that kind of ignorance.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Story_Dog: I had a dog named Rex. Toughest little mutt you ever saw. He saved my life once... I hope he's still out there somewhere.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Story_Lost: I got lost hiking once. Three days alone in the woods. Thought I was done for. Funny how that feels like a warm-up now.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Story_Neighbor: There was this old woman on my street who always watched everyone from her porch. Turns out she was the one keeping track of everything. She probably knew it was coming before any of us.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Story_NightShif: I once locked myself inside my workplace on a night shift. Spent six hours trying to get out. Good training for what came next.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Story_RoadTrip: Before all this, my car broke down in the middle of nowhere on a road trip. Spent two days fixing it with zip ties and prayers.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Survive: Future? My plan is to get through today.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Surviving: I've been better, but I'm surviving.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_TalkingDoesntHe: Yes... but talking about it doesn't help.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Tired: I'm tired, but still on my feet.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_ToldThemMoreOft: I'd have told people what they meant to me more often.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Tomato: Why does a tomato always run away from the ATM?
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_TooGoodToBeTrue: I'd be suspicious. Places that good are traps.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_TrappedForDays: Being trapped in a store surrounded by zombies for 3 days.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_TryNotToThink: Maybe... I try not to think about it too much.

IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Worried: I'm a bit worried about the future.

IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyAlready1: This body has already been examined...
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyAlready2: There's nothing left to autopsy here.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyAlready3: Someone has already performed an autopsy on this body.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyAlready4: Everything useful has already been extracted...
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyAlready5: This corpse has already been fully examined.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyAlready6: Yeah right, like I'm going to get anything from doing this.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyInfected1: Hm… fresh. I can almost hear it bubbling. Perfect.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyInfected2: Nice… a sample trying to bite me back.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyInfected3: This thing is so active it should be paying rent.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyInfected4: Whoa… that’s way too alive for my taste. If it jumps, I’m out.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyInfected5: Sample collected successfully. And I kept all my fingers!
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyNothing1: Nothing? Really? Not even enough to stain a napkin.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyNothing2: Not a single useful drop… congratulations, champ.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyNothing3: Ugh… dry like my sense of humor.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyNothing4: Zero sample. Zero use. Zero patience.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyNothing5: Empty. Just wasted time and hope.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyTainted1: Ugh… this looks like expired jam.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyTainted2: Oh great… blood with pudding texture. Useless.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyTainted3: Damn. Not even a lab would accept this in the trash.
IGUI_PlayerText_AutopsyTainted5: Clots, clots, and… more clots. Wonderful.
IGUI_PlayerText_InvalidSample: This isn’t a sample. It’s an insult to science.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueBodyPartCollected1: My God… what am I doing with my life?
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueBodyPartCollected2: Honestly, getting bitten might be better than this.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueBodyPartCollected3: Almost threw up, but I finished.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueBodyPartCollected4: This is messed up… but science is science.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueBodyPartCollected5: This better be worth it in the end.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueClean1: Let’s make this presentable… or at least less gross.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueClean2: Nothing like a sterilized table with a hint of despair.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueClean3: There… now it almost looks professional.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueClean4: Gross… but at least it’s shiny now.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueClean5: Clean table. Now I can pretend I’m organized.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueGetRemains1: Alright… let’s get this organic mass out of here.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueGetRemains2: Ugh… but someone has to be the responsible adult.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueGetRemains4: Done. Remains removed with questionable dignity.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueGetRemains5: Ugh… if I ever get used to this, please lock me up.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueNoContainer: No container. Where am I supposed to store it? In my pocket?
IGUI_PlayerText_MorguePlace1: Okay… onto the table. Try not to fall this time.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorguePlace2: Right. Let the fun begin… I guess.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorguePlace3: Alright… placed with a touch of morbid care.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorguePlace5: Alright… time to turn you into science.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueRemoveCorpse1: Alright… body bag and end of story.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueRemoveCorpse2: Better bag it before it develops a personality.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueRemoveCorpse4: This won’t turn into science. Just dirty work.
IGUI_PlayerText_MorgueRemoveCorpse5: At least it’s officially off the table now.
IGUI_PlayerText_NeedSpectrometer: I need a spectrometer for this.
IGUI_PlayerText_TestNegative1: Negative. Scientific miracle or pure luck?
IGUI_PlayerText_TestNegative5: Negative. Who said I’m easy to kill?
IGUI_PlayerText_TestPositive: Positive. The infection is just starting.
IGUI_PlayerText_TestPositive1: Yeah… that’s definitely not good news.
IGUI_PlayerText_TestPositive2: Fantastic… now I just wait to drop dead.
IGUI_PlayerText_TestPositive3: Positive. Great. Exactly the diagnosis I was hoping for.
IGUI_PlayerText_TestPositive4: Positive. Good to know before I start to rot.
IGUI_PlayerText_TestPositive6: Well then. Facts don’t lie. It's positive.

IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s001: You wake up with a hammering headache. After a long moment of observation, you realize the world you once knew has collapsed. Everything around has turned into soulless corpses staggering on the streets. Some of them, driven by hunger, are devouring chunks of fresh flesh... <LINE> <LINE> No matter what, you must survive first. <LINE> <LINE> The most essential thing for survival is water. Find some water to prepare for the survival journey ahead.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s002: The next important thing is food. Search for food around here.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s003: You remember your younger brother, the only one who ever cared about you, who is studying at Riverside high school. Even though your own survival is already a problem, you still want to go to that school to look for him. You whisper... brother, don't die.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s004: ...through the conversation, you learn that this woman is the vice principal. She says she remembers your brother. Five days before the outbreak, the city police and a group of strangers came to the school to collect blood samples from all students, then took your brother and four other students away. She doesn't know anything else. <LINE> <LINE> Perhaps you need to go to the Riverside Police Department for more information.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s005: ...you ask this police officer about the events 5 days before the outbreak. He says only the Police Chief knows the details; officers like him only follow orders. <LINE> <LINE> You ask about the Chief, and he says the Chief was not at the station when the apocalypse happened, then gives you the Police Chief's home address.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s006: From the Official Request for Coordination, you learn that the team that took your brother belongs to the Military Research Facility located in Hog Wallow Forest. <LINE> <LINE> To find your brother, you must go to the Military Research Facility.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s007: ...from the transfer document and the test report, you learn that your brother was taken to the Finnegan Research Group in Louisville.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s008: ...through the conversation, you learn that she is a research scientist at this facility. She states that no agency or test subject has come here during the time you mentioned. <LINE> <LINE> Go to the Louisville Metro Police Department to find more clues.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s009: ...through the conversation, you learn that he is a Lieutenant at this station. He knows about the transfer mission from the Military Research Facility, but the unit dispatched was ambushed by a group of strangers. The station sent reinforcements, but no updates ever came because the outbreak prevented them from reaching the site. He does not know the exact location of the ambush. <LINE> <LINE> Hint: You can search along the roads from the Military Research Facility to the Finnegan Research Group
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s010: You identify the ambush site by the uniforms on the bodies and the matching vehicle plates listed in the transfer document. You feel a growing sense of unease when you see that all of them are lying completely motionless.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s011: There is no one left alive around you. You feel a faint glimmer of hope when you realize your brother is not among the dead here. The only clue is a hastily written note in blood with three letters: MUL
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s042: ...Looking into the room, you are shocked to see your younger brother inside. You once thought you would never be able to see him again, so realizing that he is still alive and well, you can barely hold back your emotions.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s043: You pull your brother into a tight embrace and catch a glimpse of tears welling up in his eyes. Both of you are overwhelmed with joy at knowing your family has survived. <LINE> <LINE> When you ask about what happened before, your brother tells you that after arriving at the military camp, he was invited to join the nation's Super Soldier research project. Not long after, he was transferred to another facility that the scientists claimed was more suitable for him. <LINE> <LINE> However, during the transfer, the convoy was attacked by another group. Everyone was killed except him and one scientist. <LINE> <LINE> He was then taken to Raven Creek by that group, where scientists continued to study him. But the very next day, the entire building fell into chaos, zombies flooded the place, tearing apart every living being they encountered. <LINE> <LINE> More than a dozen armed personnel protected and escorted him out of the building and fled the city. Along the way, he witnessed things that filled him with overwhelming terror. <LINE> <LINE> By the time they reached a remote area, only four people were left alive, including him. After that, he was picked up by a helicopter and flown to an unknown location, before finally being brought here a few days ago. <LINE> <LINE> When the two doctors saw him, they questioned him and mentioned that someone was still searching for him. Hearing that, he realized that you were still alive. <LINE> <LINE> After finishing his story, your brother asks about you and the outside world. You tell him about your search for him and how terrifying the world beyond has become. Hearing this, he falls into deep thought. <LINE> <LINE> After taking a moment to steady your emotions, you suggest that the two of you go outside and talk with Dr. Venter.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s044: ...Dr. Venter explains that when he and his assistant arrived here, they never expected the test subject to match the description of your younger brother so closely. After speaking with him in person, he is almost certain that he has found the right person. <LINE> <LINE> Throughout this time, he has deliberately delayed the final stage of the experiment under the pretense of further examinations, waiting for you to arrive. <LINE> <LINE> When you ask about the experiment, Dr. Venter explains that this serum is designed to push human beings beyond their natural limits. It doesn't merely increase strength or endurance, but also enhances judgment, reflexes, and sensory perception… The serums he previously gave you only enhanced abilities within normal human limits, which is why they caused almost no side effects. <LINE> <LINE> This serum, however, is different. All previous test subjects were unable to withstand the biological changes, resulting in degeneration and death after about seven days. Your brother is considered a suitable candidate because the test data suggests his body may be able to adapt after the transformation. Still, this conclusion is based on data alone, and unexpected outcomes may occur during the actual process. <LINE> <LINE> If successful, your brother will gain abilities that surpass human limits, and it would also give Dr. Venter the opportunity to develop a more stable and safer version of the serum. After explaining everything clearly, he suggests that you and your brother talk privately to make a decision. <LINE> <LINE> When the conversation ends, your brother returns to his room, weighed down with conflicting thoughts. You understand that this decision can only be made by your brother himself, and that you need to talk to him to truly understand how he feels.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s045: ...You ask your brother what he thinks about all this. He doesn't answer right away, remaining silent for a long time before suddenly asking about his adoptive parents. You tell him that you don't know what has happened to them either. <LINE> <LINE> He grows quiet again, then asks whether the world could ever return to what it once was. Without waiting for an answer, he softly says that perhaps the world as it is now might actually be better. There would be no more bullies at school, no more street thugs blocking his way, and no more isolating, judgmental stares. <LINE> <LINE> You never imagined that your brother's past life had been filled with so much pain. You place a hand on his shoulder and tell him that from now on, you'll be by his side, and no one will ever bully him again. <LINE> <LINE> Lowering his head, your brother speaks of the bloodthirsty images of the zombies he has witnessed. All of it has only deepened his desire to become stronger, strong enough to bury his scars and survive the terrifying creatures outside. To him, this experiment is an opportunity. If it succeeds, he will no longer be a burden, and Dr. Venter may even be able to create a serum capable of strengthening you as well… <LINE> <LINE> In the end, your brother decides to accept the experiment. You choose to respect his decision.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s046: ...You tell Dr. Venter about your brother's decision. He lets out a sigh of relief, as if a heavy burden has finally been lifted from his shoulders, and informs you that the experiment will begin the following day.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s047: It's time for the experiment Dr. Venter scheduled. Go and speak with him.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s048: ...Dr. Venter tells you that everything is fully prepared, but if anything unexpected occurs, he will need your assistance. He points to a vial of liquid and explains that it is a serum he named the Super Human Serum, the culmination of many years of research. <LINE> <LINE> He explains to your brother that a few hours after the injection, he will experience intense pain throughout his entire body as his muscles and bones are stimulated to grow. The pain could even cause cardiac arrest and death, which is why Dr. Venter will have to administer a specially formulated painkiller on a regular basis. <LINE> <LINE> However, the maximum dosage can only prevent cardiac arrest, the remaining pain must be endured on his own. This process may last for about a day, so Dr. Venter stresses that he must not give up. <LINE> <LINE> After hearing this, your brother nods firmly. <LINE> <LINE> Confirm with Dr. Venter to begin the experiment.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s049: Dr. Venter and his assistant begin the Super Human Serum experiment. After a series of preparations, your brother's arms and legs are secured to the hospital bed. Moments later, Dr. Venter injects the Super Human Serum into his body. <LINE> <LINE> Wait a few hours to observe the reaction.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s050: You see the veins on your brother's body bulging, his limbs twitching, his teeth clenched tightly as if enduring unbearable pain. Ask Dr. Venter about his current condition.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s051: ...Dr. Venter says the serum has begun altering his body, and that the current state is a normal side effect. He will inject your brother with a special painkiller to help him endure the pain. He adds that the injection will be administered every six hours, and that after about a day, the pain should gradually subside. <LINE> <LINE> Continue waiting for the experiment to progress.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s052: Dr. Venter is looking for you. Go and talk to him in the laboratory.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s053: ...Dr. Venter speaks to you in a state of deep anxiety. He tells you that your brother's pain has not subsided at all so far, whereas in previous experiments, this condition usually only lasted for about one day. <LINE> <LINE> Although he had prepared more painkillers than expected, the remaining supply is now running dangerously low. Therefore, he needs you to find a large amount of common Painkillers, or the medicinal herb Black Sage, so that he can continue producing the special pain-relief medicine. <LINE> <LINE> He hopes you can gather enough within three days. If not, he will be forced to intervene directly with your brother's body. This method may have long-term effects on your brother, and he is extremely reluctant to resort to it. <LINE> <LINE> Looking again at your brother's body, now massive and brimming with strength, you silently swear that you will not allow him to die before your eyes. <LINE> <LINE> Note: Black Sage can be found by foraging in the forest.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s054: Dr. Venter takes all of the materials and immediately begins producing more painkillers. You continue waiting for the experiment to progress.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s055: Dr. Venter has something to tell you. Go and speak with him in the laboratory.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s056: ...Dr. Venter tells you that your brother's pain has been greatly reduced. Test results and other physical indicators also show positive signs. The transformation process is nearing its end, and the next stage will be adaptation. Based on previous experiments, this stage usually lasts about one day. <LINE> <LINE> Dr. Venter hopes that everything will proceed smoothly. You continue waiting for the experiment to progress.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s057: Dr. Venter is looking for you. Go and talk to him in the laboratory.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s058: ...Dr. Venter tells you that although your brother's body has become powerful and physically imposing, he is completely unable to control it. His consciousness and thinking remain unaffected. All of his internal organs are healthy, some even surpass those of a normal human. He can still speak and feel every physical touch, yet he is entirely unable to move. He explains that this condition appeared after the serum-induced transformation process ended, and that he has not yet identified the cause. He says he will need several more days to continue his investigating.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s059: Dr. Venter has something to tell you. Go and speak with him in the laboratory.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s060: ...Dr. Venter tells you that he has not yet found a solution to this condition and is forced to wait for now. The research may take a considerable amount of time, but if he makes any discoveries, he will inform you immediately. <LINE> <LINE> You do not feel despair, because at least your brother is still alive, and this place is relatively safe. Aside from waiting for Dr. Venter to find a solution, perhaps you can also try to find other ways to help your brother. <LINE> <LINE> In addition, Dr. Venter informs you that the nutritional fluid supply is nearly depleted. Fortunately, your brother's digestive system is still functioning normally. During this period, someone will need to personally take care of his meals. <LINE> <LINE> Although Dr. Bassler can assist with this, her expertise lies in research and supporting Dr. Venter's work. As a result, only you can ensure the best possible condition for your brother. <LINE> <LINE> Note: Right-click on the NPC to display the care option.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s990: After enduring countless hardships, you finally found your brother. But surviving in this world has never been easy, especially when trying to endure it together. Your brother has passed away, leaving behind an aching longing and an unrelenting sense of self-blame within you.
IGUI_VLQ_1_HaloText1_q1s006: I should look for clues in these documents if no one else survived
IGUI_VLQ_1_HaloText1_q1s007: It looks like someone's on the roof

Instead, he is worried because his assistant went out to gather food more than a day ago and has yet to return. She would normally be back within a day. He hopes you can help find her. Dr. Venter believes she is likely still wandering around food stores in the town, as she mentioned there was still plenty of food left somewhere nearby.
IGUI_VLQ_2_Desc_q1s014: ...through the conversation, you learn that she is Dr. Bassler, Dr. Venter's assistant. Since the outbreak, all support from headquarters has been disrupted, and it seems something has happened there as well. Dr. Venter and his assistant have to manage everything themselves; many things that used to rely on headquarters have now become very difficult, especially since the assistant is a woman. <LINE> <LINE> You are the first survivor they've encountered since the city was overrun by zombies, and Dr. Venter feels you are trustworthy.
