IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s001: You hear faint noises coming from the barricaded house ahead of you. You hesitate, unsure whether you should investigate further.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s002: You see two people inside the room: a middle-aged man watching you with clear suspicion, and a woman lying on the bed with her leg braced in a splint, seemingly injured, looking at you with exhausted eyes. <LINE> <LINE> The man asks whether you are military personnel sent to provide assistance. You shake your head, act friendly, and explain that you just happened to pass by. <LINE> <LINE> Seeing that you mean no harm, the man lowers his guard somewhat. He sits down, takes the hand of the woman lying on the bed, and says that there is nothing left here; if you have no further business, he hopes you will leave. <LINE> <LINE> After saying that, he silently wipes the sweat from the woman's face, clearly not wishing to continue the conversation.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s003: ...The man seems grateful and noticeably friendlier. He introduces himself as Bob, and the woman beside him as Kate, his wife. <LINE> <LINE> Bob goes on to explain their current situation. Kate has a broken leg and cannot move. She has also been coughing and running a fever since yesterday; Bob assumes it is just a common flu. However, there is no proper medicine left in the house. All of their food so far has been gathered by Bob, who risks going outside to find it. Bob has repeatedly called for help over the radio, but no one has come. He worries about Kate and cannot go too far, and there is nothing left in the surrounding area. Since Kate started coughing and running a fever, he has fallen into deeper despair, shouting into the radio and waiting hopelessly for rescue. <LINE> <LINE> After finishing his story, Bob grips the food you gave him more tightly; with it, his wife may survive for a few more days. <LINE> <LINE> After hearing Bob and Kate's situation, you hesitate, unsure whether you should help them. <LINE> <LINE> Talk to Bob if you decide to help them..
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s004: ...You take the initiative and offer to help the couple. Bob and Kate are deeply grateful; recently, they have barely seen any kindness from others. All they have witnessed along the way has been rejection, looting, and the coldness of human hearts. <LINE> <LINE> Bob grips your hand tightly, thanking you even though you have not done anything yet. After calming his emotions, Bob asks you to help him find some medical supplies. He says Kate urgently needs them. <LINE> <LINE> Required supplies: 1x Paracetamol, 6x Antibiotics, 1x Cold Pack
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s005: ...Bob takes the medicine you give him, clearly moved. With these supplies, he believes his wife will recover soon. <LINE> <LINE> After a while, Bob hesitantly speaks up again, hoping you can help him one more time by finding suitable food for Kate. He needs rice to cook porridge, along with sugar and salt to help replenish electrolytes. These foods are essential for Kate's recovery. <LINE> <LINE> Required supplies: Rice (-120 hunger), Sugar (-30 hunger), Salt (-15 hunger)
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s006: ...Bob takes the food you give him. This time, he cannot hold back his tears. <LINE> <LINE> There has been nothing left to eat around here for several days; he once considered risking going farther away, but that would have been dangerous for both him and Kate, and there was no guarantee he would find the exact food Kate needed, like the supplies you brought. That is why these supplies are incredibly precious to them. <LINE> <LINE> You look at Bob's gaunt face, listen to his words, and realize that he has not been eating properly for many days. Perhaps he has been giving most of the food to his wife. Malnutrition has severely weakened Bob's physical condition...
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s007: ...Some time has passed. Return to check on Bob and Kate's current condition.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s008: ...Bob says that despite taking medicine and eating properly, Kate's condition has not improved and has even worsened. The medicine and food you previously gave him for Kate have also run out. He is extremely worried and hopes you can once again find more medicine and food for Kate, just like before. <LINE> <LINE> Required supplies: <LINE> <LINE> - Food: Rice (-120 hunger), Sugar (-30 hunger), Salt (-15 hunger) <LINE> <LINE> - Medicine: 1x Paracetamol, 6x Antibiotics, 1x Cold Pack
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s009: ...Bob takes the medicine and food, repeatedly thanking you. He then gives Kate her medicine and cooks food for her, hoping that she will recover in a few days.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s010: ...Some time has passed. Return to check on Bob and Kate's current condition.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s011: ...Bob says that Kate's condition continues to worsen even though he keeps giving her medicine and proper food. Kate begins to drift in and out of consciousness, occasionally showing strange symptoms. Bob gradually realizes that Kate is not suffering from a simple flu or fever. However, he insists she was never bitten or injured by the undead, so there should be no way for her to turn. <LINE> <LINE> Bob clutches his head, clearly panicking. He begs you to once again find more medicine and food for Kate. <LINE> <LINE> Required supplies: <LINE> <LINE> - Food: Rice (-120 hunger), Sugar (-30 hunger), Salt (-15 hunger) <LINE> <LINE> - Medicine: 1x Paracetamol, 6x Antibiotics, 1x Cold Pack
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s012: ...Bob takes the supplies from you in a distraught state. Choking back tears, he says that Kate's strange symptoms are becoming more frequent, and her skin has also begun to change. Bob is close to panic. <LINE> <LINE> Seeing Bob like this, you desperately want to do something more meaningful. But Kate seems to be turning, what more can you possibly do...
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s013: ...Some time has passed. Return to check on Bob and Kate's current condition.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s014: ...Seeing the current situation, you understand that Kate does not have much time left. You advise Bob to put an end to her suffering. Surely, she would not want to turn into that hideous creature and harm him. <LINE> <LINE> Bob says nothing after hearing this, burying his face in the hand that is holding Kate's, his shoulders trembling slightly...
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s015: ...You tell Bob that you have a serum that can eliminate the virus that turns people into the undead, but you are unsure how effective it would be on Kate. <LINE> <LINE> Upon hearing this, Bob suddenly snaps to his senses, gripping your shoulders tightly and begging you to let his wife use the serum. He says he is willing to pay any price. <LINE> <LINE> Inject Kate if you are ready.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s016: ...You have injected Kate with the antiserum. The serum needs time to take effect. Wait a few hours to see how it affects Kate.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s017: ...Some time has passed; by now, the serum should have clearly taken effect. Go and check on Kate's condition.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s018: ...Bob says that Kate's condition has improved significantly. She no longer shows strange symptoms, and her skin and breathing are gradually returning to normal. Although she is still unconscious, her condition is much better. <LINE> <LINE> Bob understands that what you injected into Kate saved her life. It is an extremely valuable item in the current world, yet you were willing to share it. He will remember this forever.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s019: Some time has passed. Go to Bob and Kate's house to see how they are doing now.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s020: ...You sigh and pat Bob on the shoulder, telling him that perhaps some kind of miracle will still happen.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s100: ...Return to Bob and Kate's house to check on their current situation.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s101: ...When you enter Bob and Kate's room, you find them embracing each other, no longer alive. Beside them lies a letter Bob left behind. You understand that they made their own choice. They chose to remain together, even in death...
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s102: ...When you enter Bob and Kate's room, you find them embracing each other, no longer alive. A letter lies on the floor, addressed to the person he loved most. IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day01_S: Is this thing on? I think I finally got it working
Marcus and Ray are asleep. So it's just us
Electrical tip: You need a screwdriver. For everything
It's the most important tool you'll find
Without one, you can't even take apart a radio
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day02_S: I was an engineering student. Third year
Ray found me three weeks ago. Brought me here
Carpentry tip: Always have an escape route. Second floor? Use a sheet rope
A nail, a sheet, and a hammer
Don't get trapped upstairs without one
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day03_S: Fixed the generator yesterday. Carbon on the spark plug
Marcus tried to help. He held the flashlight
Electrical tip: Never run a generator indoors
The fumes build up fast. You won't wake up
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day04_S: Found some old engineering books yesterday
Reminds me of pulling all-nighters in the library
Carpentry tip: Need wood but can't chop trees?
Interior doors are just free planks waiting to be claimed
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day05_S: Ray snores. Just putting that out there
Marcus pretends he doesn't hear it. I know he does
Electrical tip: Generators chew through fuel
If your fridge is empty, turn it off
Don't waste gas cooling empty air
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day06_S: Marcus tried to help with the antenna yesterday
He held the ladder. That was... helpful
Carpentry tip: Want that nice couch? Be careful moving it
It takes skill to not break furniture
Don't rush or you'll just have scrap wood
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day07_S: Ray showed me how to set a snare last week
I think he's warming up to me
Electrical tip: Save your electronic scrap
You'll need it to repair the generator eventually
It's not junk, it's spare parts
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day08_S: I've been boosting our signal range
Found copper wire in an old house. Hello, new listeners!
Carpentry tip: Organization saves lives. Build crates
Piles of loot on the floor will just slow you down
Label them if you have paint
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day09_S: Wonder if there are working universities out there
Electrical tip: Digital watches are everywhere
Don't ignore them. They're perfect for practicing
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day10_S: Marcus asked about my family yesterday
They were in Louisville when it started
Carpentry tip: Garbage bags aren't just for trash
You'll need them for rain collectors later
Save everyone you find. Trust me
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day11_S: Found a ham radio yesterday. Still works!
I'm fixing it up as a backup
Electrical tip: Ham radios have way better range
Walkie talkies are fine for a convoy, but useless for distance
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day12_S: But I think he means it affectionately
Carpentry tip: Fences are okay. Log walls are better
Four logs and some ripped sheets
It's heavy work, but nothing's getting through
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day13_S: They were... interesting. But he tried
Electrical tip: You can build noise makers with spare parts
A radio, some sensors... good for distractions
Lure them away from where you sleep
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day14_S: I keep thinking about trying to reach Louisville
Not that I've told Marcus or Ray
Carpentry tip: Dirt floors are depressing. And dirty
Use planks to lay proper wooden flooring
You can claim any building if you fix it up
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day15_S: I met some people yesterday! A group heading east
One of them knows about solar power
Electrical tip: Remote triggers are basically modified V1 controllers
Trigger a device from a safe distance
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day16_S: Talked to that group again. They're staying nearby
They're planning a route to Louisville
Mechanics tip: Protect your car's engine
If the hood is damaged, the engine takes the hits
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day17_S: The group has a car they're fixing up
I offered to help. Turns out I'm useful
Electrical tip: Timer switches aren't just for baking
Set a noise maker to go off in ten minutes
Be far away when it does
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day18_S: The group leader is named Sarah. She was a nurse
They've got a mechanic named Tom
Mechanics tip: It's getting colder. Check your car heater
You can sleep in a warm car if you have to
Beats freezing to death in a tent
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day19_S: Marcus and Ray don't know I've been meeting them
I don't know why I haven't told them
Electrical tip: Motion sensors from home alarms can be repurposed
If you know what you're doing, you can make a perimeter
A warning system that never sleeps
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day20_S: Replaced brake pads yesterday. My first time
Tom said I'm a quick learner. That felt good
Mechanics tip: Not all cars are equal
Vans and trucks carry way more gear
Sometimes speed doesn't matter as much as storage
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day21_S: I've been learning so much from Tom
Ray would probably approve. He's practical like that
Electrical tip: Generators degrade over time
If it starts smoking, fix it or it explodes
Electronic scrap is the only way to patch the boards
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day22_S: Sarah asked if I wanted to come with them
To Louisville. I said I'd think about it
Mechanics tip: Loud cars equal death
A damaged muffler draws them in from miles away
Install a good one or stay off the road
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day23_S: I already know my answer. I've always known
I'm just scared to admit it
Electrical tip: House lamps are a great source of bulbs and wire
Dismantle them if you need parts for bigger projects
Even a small desk lamp has what you need to fix a generator
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day24_S: I said yes. I'm going to Louisville
The group leaves in six days
Mechanics tip: Don't walk if you can drive
Don't drive one car if you can take two. Tie a second car to yours
Tow it back to base for parts
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day25_S: Five days left. The car is almost ready
I fixed the alternator myself. Tom supervised
Electrical tip: alternators charge your battery
Dead battery while running means bad alternator
Listen for whining sounds under the hood
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day26_S: I told Marcus. He joked about me outgrowing them
But his eyes were sad. Ray just nodded
Mechanics tip: Car dead? Might just be the battery
You can charge it with a battery charger
Don't scrap a good car over a flat battery
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day27_S: Three days left. I keep looking at them differently
Electrical tip: Streetlights are gone. But you can rig worklights
Power them with a generator for night defense
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day28_S: Two days left. The car's ready. I packed my stuff
I'm bringing the ham radio. For emergencies
Mechanics tip: Lost the key? You can hotwire it
You need electronics skill and mechanics skill
Cross the wires and drive away
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day29_S: Last full day. Marcus gave me his lucky compass
Ray marked dangerous areas on his map for me
Electrical tip: always have a backup radio

IGUI_Bandits_Speech_ZSUpstairs_Female_21: Hostile on on the upper floor.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.1_A: It's a long story. I was rescued, just like you.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.1_Q: How did you get in here?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.1.1_A: Take your time and rest first. When you're ready, feel free to look around. We'll talk about the details later. I can promise, you'll not get bored.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.1.1_Q: Can I help with any of the issues here?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.1_A: This place requires maintenance, and we needed supplies. They went out to get them, but don't worry, things are under control.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.1_Q: Why did the others have to leave?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.2_A: Soon, I hope. Don't worry, we're in regular radio contact.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.2_Q: When will the others come back?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.3.1.2_A: Luke is our scientist. He works with me in the lab.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.3.1.3_A: Martha takes care of our crops and food supplies.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.3.1.4_A: Eli's our mechanic. He keeps this place running.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.3.1_A: There's David, Luke, Martha, and Eli.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.3.1_Q: Who are the others living here?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.3.2.1_A: An Oligocene aquifer provides us with a steady water supply.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.3.2_A: We have some scarce food reserves, but we also grow crops locally. It's not much, but we're managing.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.3.2_Q: Do we have enough supplies for everyone?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.3_A: It's me, four others and you.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2.3_Q: How many of you live here?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2_A: Yes, but they had to leave for various reasons.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1.2_Q: Are there any other people here?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1.1_A: It's not connected to the central computer, so it has to be turned on and off manually. Eli tried to fix it, but he gave up.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1.1_Q: How do I use the water pump?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1.2.1_A: Redundancy for safety reasons. But also, we switch to backup one, when we need to fix the main one.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1.2.1_Q: Why do we have two generators?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1.2.2.1.1.1_: Amazing! I have to admit, I was worried about you a little. I'm happy that you made it, and I'm happy for the fuel too.
I brought the truck, Emma. We have the fuel for the generator.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1.2.2.1.1_A: Fuel is a scarce resource. Our intel shows that there is a fuel truck located on Dixie Highway leading to Muldraugh Ruins. Can you get it here?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1.2.2.1.1_Q: How do we get more fuel?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1.2.2.1_A: That would be a disaster. Central heating would shut down and we would freeze to death within hours.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1.2.2.1_Q: What happens if we run out of fuel?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1.2.2_A: The only way to check is to use Noah - the central computer.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1.2.2_Q: How much fuel do we have left?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1.2_A: Generators are operated by Noah - a central computer. However, fuel is added manually through an inlet on the surface.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1.2_Q: How do I use the power generators?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.10.1_A: Great news! Thanks! You never know when one of these will become handy, you know?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.10_A: Good observation. We lost some of our tools during one of our recent scavenge missions. There is a bag full of tools in what is left of the Community Center in March Ridge. Can you get it back for us?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.10_Q: I think we need more tools.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1_A: Engineering room. That's where power generators and water pump is located.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.1_Q: I found a room with loud machinery.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.2_A: Great find! Noah controls and monitors many systems in the base. I'd advise caution before changing anything.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.2_Q: I found Noah, a computer of some kind.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.3_A: Perfect! Enjoy the food, but also take care of the plants.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.4.1_A: I like crime novels in general.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.4_A: Nice! Did you find anything interesting?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.5.1_A: To be honest, faith is all we might have left.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.5.1_Q: How can you still believe after all of this?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.5_A: Yep. It's been here since before us.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.6.1.1.1_A: Awesome. I will conduct the research soon. I hope it will bring us some useful insights.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.6.1.1.1_Q: I brought a zombie corpse to the lab.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.6.1.1_A: I don't know. But we have to start somewhere.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.6.1.1_Q: Are you saying you are looking for a cure?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.6.1_A: Well. We are trying to understand the virus so maybe we can do something about it.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.6.1_Q: What kind of research are you conducting?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.6.2_A: Good. I will continue my research shortly. We need to understand why some of us remain uninfected.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.6.2_Q: I brought a corpse of the non-infected to the lab.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.6_A: Yes! It's where we conduct our research.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.6_Q: I think I found a laboratory.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.7.1_A: I knew you would notice that at some point. Yes, there were more of us. But they are dead, ok?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.7.1_Q: There are beds with personal items of more than 5 people in bedroom.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.7_A: Yes, choose the bed you want.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.7_Q: I found the bedroom. Can I sleep there?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.8.1.1_A: Oh right, I forgot you don't remember things. It's the nuclear fallout. I'm sorry, but the world as you knew is now gone. When you're ready, you can go outside and see for yourself. Just be careful there!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.8.1.1_Q: What radiation are you speaking about?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.8.1_A: They are crucial when we need to go outside. They protect you from the radiation.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.8.1_Q: There are hazmat suits in the armory, why would we need them?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.8_A: You bet! While it may not seem so, we're still in Kentucky.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.8_Q: I found the armory. Can I get some guns?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_100.9_A: Yes. It's a crucial function of the Ark. Everything and everyone that comes from the outside must be decontaminated.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1000.1_A: The central heating must be off. We should fix it before we freeze to death!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1000.2_A: Shit! We need to check the generator and fuel levels!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1000.3.1_A: Take some potassioum iodine pills immediately!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1000.3.1_Q: How can we recover from radiation poisoning?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1000.3_A: Gosh! It seems like radiation poisoning.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1000.3_Q: I feel sick. What's going on?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1000.4_A: Check the CO2 levels and make sure the ventilation is working!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1000.5.1_A: Good! CO2 levels should be dropping now.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1000.5_A: We need to check the air intake on the surface!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1000.5_Q: I've noticed CO2 levels are rising despite ventilation being turn on!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_1_A: My name is Emma. I'm a survivor, just like you. I'm a doctor.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2.1_A: Yes, as safe as we can be, given the circumstances, for now at least.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2.2.1_A: We have an archive with tapes you can listen to. They tell the history of this place.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2.2.1_Q: Tell me more about the organization that built this place.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2.2_A: We're not entirely sure. It's some kind of military bunker we were lucky to find. It seems to have been built by a strange organization for long-term survival.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2.3.1.1.1_A: David is our leader. He was the one that found me.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_200.1.2_A: I planned to smoke it after getting bit. But it never happened.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_200.1.2_Q: Why did you carry a cigarrete if you quit?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_200.1_A: I quit. But, I do carry one last with me. Here, enjoy.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_200.2_Q: I can barely see. Do you have my glasses?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.1_A: It's ok, it's just a dream. You're safe here.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.2_A: Sorry to hear that, but on the bright side, your memories are returning.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.2_Q: I had a bad dream again. I am beginning to remember things...
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.3.1_A: Yes, that's when we found you. You were moments away from getting bitten. Hopefully we got to you in time.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.3.1_Q: My last dream was about me surrounded by zombies with little chance of survival.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.3_A: What did you dream about exactly?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.3_Q: Dream again. Now, I remember what happened to me.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.4.1.1_A: I'm a doctor, but not a shrink.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.4.1.1_Q: In my dream, the voice told me about a shattered seal... And about a judgement of some kind.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.4.1_A: Okay. What did the voice say to you?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.4.1_Q: I'm not crazy. My dreams are not my imagination. It felt very real.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.4_A: Take it easy. Your mind may still need time to adjust.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.4_Q: My dreams are changing. I heard some voice.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.5.1.1.1.1.1: Theoretically, some seeds may have survived. You could grow it here.
If I can't find the plant, then I will find the seeds.
You're joking... The ecosystem has collapsed. You've seen the world, right?
I am going to find it.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.5.1.1.1.1_A: Okay. But what exactly do you want us to do regarding comfrey.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.5.1.1.1.1_Q: I know, but you're the one who mentioned faith as the only thing you have left.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.5.1.1.1_A: That plant? This seems unrelated to our cause. Honestly, waste of time.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.5.1.1.1_Q: The priest pointed to some documents that speak about comfrey.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.5.1.1_A: A priest? Who would have thought that there would be a priest left in this world.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.5.1.1_Q: I know. He's a priest and he didn't want to come with me anyway.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.5.1_A: Careful! It's better not to trust anyone!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.5.1_Q: Emma, I found a friendly survivor in Ekron.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.5.2_A: I nearly forgot about that. Bring it to the lab. I will see what I can do with it.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.5.2_Q: Took a while, but I managed to grow some comfrey.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.5.3_A: Correct. The city lies in a valley, so it was protected from the worst of the blast. It's a good place for foraging.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.5.3_Q: I found out that Fallas Lake was not destroyed.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.5_A: Stop! I don't want to hear that crazy stuff! You need to get back to reality!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.1.1.1_Q: The rituals weren't just symbolic. They had problems with the dead...
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.1.1_Q: The virus isn't new. Ancient texts mention rituals that could be connected to it.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.1_A: What did you learn? Please, tell me.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.1_Q: Emma, my dreams led me to a secret laboratory, and I learned something important about the virus.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.2.1.1_A: Did you find anything more concrete in that lab? If not, it might be worth investigating further.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.2.1.1_Q: I know that the Soviet research was later studied here, in the lab I visited.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.2.1_A: And you think that's the same organism responsible for what happened here.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.2.1_Q: The Soviets conducted excavations there. In the permafrost, they discovered some kind of preserved organism.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.2_Q: I found out that Soviets investigated the area where the ancient culture performed the rituals.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.3.1_A: Well... that's taxpayer money at work. First the Soviets, now our own idiots.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.3.1_Q: Apparently, our government had an agent in the Soviet excavation group.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.3_A: Shit! I knew it! There's always a bunch of assholes who screw everything up.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.3_Q: Emma, I saw the documents. I have proof they brought the virus here!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.4.1.1_A: Do you know what it was? Did you find any trace of that substance there?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.4.1.1_Q: I found out that Cortman injected himself with some suspicious substance.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.4.1.2_A: I need to investigate it. Put it in the lab. This may lead us somewhere.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.4.1.2_Q: Cortman's house had a secret room and I think I might have found the substance he injected himself with.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.4.1_A: That super old rich prick? Interesting. I wonder if you should pay him a visit.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.4.1_Q: One of the doctors from the lab was named Cortman. He had a clinic in Muldraugh.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.6.4_Q: I have a list of all the assholes who worked at that lab.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.7.1.1.1_A: It must be connected to the zombie outbreak.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.7.1.1.1_Q: Longevity. That's what that substance is all about.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.7.1.1_A: We need to understand what that substance is.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.7.1.1_Q: They were all part of some kind of cult.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.7.1_Q: It's not just Cortman. There were others injecting themselves.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.7_A: Let me guess. Another dream? Well, last time you were right, so I'm all ears.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.7_Q: I think I know how it all started.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.9.1.1.1_A: I'll kick your ass if you don't!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.9.1.1.1_Q: I need to go. I will come back. I promise.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.9.1.1_A: I don't want you to go!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.9.1.1_Q: I need to go alone. You stay here.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.9.1_A: I won't stop you, will I? I'm going with you!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.9.1_Q: I know that Finnegan Research Group headquarters hide some secrets.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.9_A: Are you crazy? You will never make it there alive! Why do you want to go there?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2000.9_Q: Emma, I need to go to Louisville.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2001.9.1.1.1.1.1: Go away! I don't want to see you anymore!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2001.9.1.1.1.1_Q: I was part of the team that produced the virus.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2001.9.1.1.1_Q: I remember who I was. I worked at Finnegan Research Group.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2001.9.1.1_Q: I've just learned something difficult about my past.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2001.9.1_Q: You know my dreams reveal the truth, right?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2001.9_Q: Emma, I need to tell you something.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_220.2_A: Take one of these pills. It will help you.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_220.3_A: Don't be a kid! There's a lot of things to do and keep you busy.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_220.4_A: Sounds like a plan! Go kill some zombies. With a little luck, you will find some cigarettes on them.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_220.4_Q: I would kill for a cigarette.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_220.5_A: Dead corpses sickness. Get rid of the corpses, there's a chute in the exit corridor.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_2_A: You're safe. Don't worry. You're in a shelter.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.1.1.1.1.1_A: Nah. I might still need you.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.1.1.1.1_Q: So, you're not afraid of me?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.1.1.1_A: We've all done things. But we all deserved a second chance.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.1.1.1_Q: How did you know you could trust me, that I wasn't dangerous?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.1.1_A: In the chaos of the last days. You were lucky we were there too.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.1_A: This may be a shock to you... You were in a coma for a couple of months.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.1.1.1_A: Get some rest first. When you're ready, you can look around and take what you need.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.1.1_A: Here, take some pills. I was worried your motor and speech functions might be affected, but you're fine. The headache will pass.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.1.1_Q: I still have a terrible headache.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.1.2.1_A: Nothing unique. We had to burn everything for safety reasons.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.1.2.1_Q: Did I have anything with me that would help me remember who I was?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.1.2.2_A: Well, I hope your memories will come back to you. Anyway, you look like a Bobby to me.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.1.2.2_Q: I don't know what my name is.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.1.2_A: That's normal in your situation. It will take time before memories come back to you.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.1.2_Q: I don't remember who I was.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.1_A: We had to perform a craniotomy to treat internal bleeding.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.1_Q: What exactly did you do to my head?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.2.1_A: We have a lab here. And I'm a doctor, remember?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.2.1_Q: How were you able to test my blood?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.2.2_A: Yeah. At this point, everyone who's still human is considered immune.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2.2_A: According to your blood tests, you're not. You're also immune to the airborne strain of the virus.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3.2_A: You had a head injury when we found you. You're lucky we had the equipment and the people to help. Your head may still ache, and your body might feel weak.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.1.1.1.1_Q: I will revenge Dave and Martha. I promise!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.1.1.1_Q: Emma, Dave and Martha are dead. I'm so sorry...
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.1.1_A: They were on their way back and they passed Rosewood Ruins already. They planned to make a final stop at one of the houses on the way here.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.1.1_Q: What's the last known location of Dave's group?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.1_A: Radio has been silent for some time now. I'm worried. Something is wrong.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.1_Q: Have you heard from the others?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.2.1_A: Wow! That's great news! That seriously increases our range of operation.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.2.1_Q: I also found a working car.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.2_A: That's... that's good, I guess. But it won't bring them back...
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.2_Q: Emma, I killed those bastards who killed Dave and Martha.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.3.1_A: You're welcome. I knew you'd wake up one day.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.3.1_Q: Thanks for taking care of me while I was in coma.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.3_Q: I never had a chance to thank you for saving me.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.4.1.1_A: I could, but without music, it's not the same. I wish we had music in here!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.4.1.1_Q: Why can't you dance in here?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.4.1.2_A: Piano. I used to play the piano. How I wish we had one here!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.4.1.2_Q: Besides books and clubbing, is there anything else you like to do for fun?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.4.1.3_A: Sure. But we only have a few in here and I've already watched them millions of times. I wish we had more.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.4.1.3_Q: What about movies? Do you like to watch them too?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.4.1_A: Oh you know, I love books and I've been reading them here for some time. However I miss music and dancing. I used to go to clubs and dance the night away. I miss that a lot.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.4.1_Q: What fun activities are you missing in here?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.4_A: I've been busy with various things most of the time. But I have to admit, I miss other fun activities.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.4_Q: You've been here quite a bit. Aren't you bored?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.5.1_A: My uncle used to work there when I was a kid. I know the place pretty well. I used to play in the underground there.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.5.1_Q: Why would you want to go to the warehouses south-west from Muldraugh?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.5_A: I hope it never comes to that. But if it does, we would have to find another shelter. My first stop would be the warehouses south-west from Muldraugh.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_300.5_Q: Emma, what would we do if we ever lose the Ark?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3000.1.1.1.1.1.1: Fine! Let's go. But you're still such an asshole.
We'll talk later, we're heading home. Get ready.
And you were the only reason I kept going too.
You are the only reason I keep going.
You would not, you need me. And I need you.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3000.1.1.1.1.1_Q: Well that asshole just came to save you.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3000.1.1.1.1_A: That would be a third chance for you, you asshole.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3000.1.1.1.1_Q: You said that everyone deserves a second chance. So here I am!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3000.1.1.1_Q: I did what I did, I don't know why, and I'm sorry!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3000.1.1_A: Just like you cared about everyone else when you killed them with your brilliant medicine?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3000.1.1_Q: I came because I care about you. Let's go!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3000.1_A: I told you I wanted to be alone. Why did you come?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3000.1_Q: Enough of that bullshit. I'm taking you home.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_3_A: We found you unconscious and brought you here. Relax, you're safe now.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.1_A: I'm still constructing a working model. This pathogen doesn't behave like anything in modern virology. It preserves certain functions while degrading others. It's almost selective in what it keeps. There's intent in the pattern, or something close to it. I need physical data to move forward.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.1_Q: What are your virus research results so far?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.2_A: I've completed the autopsy. The body is failing, but not entirely. Motor function persists despite catastrophic neural loss. There's no centralized brain activity that explains movement. It's as if something else has taken over coordination at a lower level. I don't understand how, but it's consistent. I need human specimen to continue.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.3_A: This subject is different. There are clear markers of exposure, but no full conversion. The organism was present, but it never took hold. Something prevented the transition entirely. I can confirm immunity, but I have no idea what caused it. We need new clues.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.3_Q: Any new updates regarding our research?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.4.1_A: Now that is a very good question, Bobby.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.4.1_Q: Would that mean that we were also pre-exposed? Injected with the symbiotic strain?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.4_A: I've analyzed the sample, it's the original strain, and I think I understand now. This version doesn't destroy the host, it integrates with it. The immune subject wasn't naturally resistant, they were pre-exposed. Injected, most likely. The symbiotic strain prevented the aggressive one from taking over.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.4_Q: How is the research going? Are we close?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.5_A: Yep. You will not believe this. The comfrey extract is doing more than slowing the process, it's reversing it. At least in early-stage samples. Even post-exposure tissue is stabilizing. If this holds, it could work after a bite. But I need to be certain. This has to be tested on someone.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.5_Q: Got any news on the ongoing research?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.6.1.1_A: No. Not now. That's unnecessary risk!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.6.1.1_Q: I want to test it on myself.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.6.1_A: I can't be sure until it is tested. If any of us gets bitten we can try it on ourselves.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.6.1_Q: Are you sure it will work?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.6.2.1_A: We have no choice. Gosh, I hope it works. Inject it immediately!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.6.2.1_Q: It just happened. I need to take the counter now.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.6.2_A: Oh no! How did this happen?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_400.6_A: This is it. I've completed the experimental counter to the infection. It doesn't remove the organism, but it forces it back into a stable state. In theory, it should work even after exposure. I've prepared couple of doses.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_4_A: Relax. You are in shock. Let's talk more and I'll leave you alone.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_5.1.1.1.1_A: I know, it's ugly. This is the reality now.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_5.1.1.1.1_Q: I found a basement. What a mess!
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_5.1.1.1_A: You would need to check the surrounding houses. Some of them have hidden entrances in the floor to the basements. Again, I need to warn you, this is dangerous. Don't go unless you are well prepared.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_5.1.1.1_Q: I want to go out and find other people. Where exactly should I go?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_5.1.1_A: In fact they are. It's either us or them now, you know.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_5.1.1_Q: Are those living outside a threat to us?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_5.1_A: We tried that, it's risky. It's been a long time since the event and most of them became very hostile.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_5.1_Q: Can we help the other people living outside?
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_5_A: Yes. There are some living underground.
IGUI_Dial_Emma_Robinson_5_Q: Are there any other survivors outside the base?
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_1_A: My name is Father James. I have nothing to give. You can have my life, that is all what is left.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_2.1.1_A: I bricked up the entrance and myself in here.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_2.1.1_Q: This place was sealed, how did you get in here?
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_2.1_Q: How long have you been here?
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1.1.1.1.1_A: The answer must be here. Seek and you shall find.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1.1.1.1_A: It's not a coincidence you are here. Truely you are guided.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1.1.1.1_Q: I believe that my dreams hold a greater meaning
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1.1.1.2_A: Maybe it had to be that way.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1.1.1.2_Q: I lost my memory, I was in a coma.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1.1.1.3.1.1_A: My child, I see it in your eyes. You are in love. That is why you will win.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1.1.1.3.1.1_Q: How did you know it's her?
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1.1.1.3.1_A: Save her and you will save the world.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1.1.1.3.1_Q: Actually Father. There is someone I need to protect now.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1.1.1.3_A: We all did. Trust in the Lord and protect what you hold dear.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1.1.1.3_Q: I have seen terrible things Father.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1.1.1_A: You have been through a lot my child.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1.1.1_Q: It spoke about something about a judgement and a dark end.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1.1_Q: I was guided by a voice speaking about the sin and a shattered seal.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1_A: We are already saved by our Lord. I need not more salvation. Why are you here anyway?
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3.1_Q: Father James. Please, allow yourself to be saved!
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3_A: This place is where I belong.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_3_Q: Father, you don't need to be here. We have a shelter. Come with me!
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_4.1.1.1.1_A: I am no scientist, my child. But if you still have hope, what I have said may guide you. Look at the note on the table.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_4.1.1.1_A: The Eastern Church wrote of it. We believed it to be a syncretism of faith and local tradition, but it carried a deeper meaning. All signs pointed to cleansing rituals using herbs, most notably comfrey. They used it because they struggled with the dead. Do you understand?
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_4.1.1.1_Q: Please tell me more, Father. What documents? Can I do something?
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_4.1.1_A: We studied old documents. We suspected this was not the first time. We searched for a way to prevent it — but we failed. May God have mercy on our souls.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_4.1.1_Q: How exactly did you try to stop it?
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_4.1_A: We tried to stop it, but we failed. May God have mercy on our souls.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_4.1_Q: What kind of meetings were held in this place?
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_4_Q: I read a note that led me here.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_5_A: May God bless you on your journey, my child.
IGUI_Dial_Father_James_5_Q: Thank you, Father. I must go now.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_10_A: Alright. The Ark is something created to protect you. A place to hide from what happened.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_10_Q: I don't understand. Just tell me clearly.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_11_A: Bobby... I need you to stay with me now. This will hurt. You lost your family. Months ago. Your mind buried that memory.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_12_A: That's a natural response. Last time, this is where you shut down. But now, you're still here.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_13.1_A: It's very real, to you. I have constructed it for you. Not as an engineer, but as your doctor. The Ark acts like a shelter for your trauma, where the healing process takes place.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_13.2_A: That is correct. It happened at your house. You weren't there. You were working late. The guilt became too much and it lead to your condition.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_13.2_Q: I think... my family was murdered...
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_13_A: Take your time. You're doing well.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_13_Q: Wait... the dreams... I remember... God...
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_14_A: She's your daughter. When you lost your family, you lost the whole world. The destroyed world pictures that. But you couldn't let her go. So you brought her with you.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_15.1.1_A: Yes, Father James. He also tried to help you.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_15.1_A: They are the other people. Monsters who killed your family. Maybe other people you could no longer trust. You dehumanized them. Maybe except for one.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_15.2_A: Your job. You blamed yourself, but also them for what happened.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_15_A: Yes. We tried many approaches. In one, we gave you a mission to stop the nuclear attack. But it did not work. You needed a world that matched how you felt.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_15_Q: So... all of this... is a therapy?
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_16_A: That's up to you. When you leave this room... you may return to the Ark. Or you may stay here. Your mind will make that choice for you. If you go back, you'll forget this again. But the pain will be less. And we'll meet again. Just like we always do.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_1_A: Welcome back Keller. How are you feeling?
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_2_A: I'm dr Noah Whitlock. I've been helping you.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_2_Q: I feel confused. Who the hell are you?
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_3_Q: I don't recognize this place. Where are we?
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_4_A: Keller. I'm going to walk you through this, step by step. You've been through a lot.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_4_Q: That's not possible. There's nothing outside the Ark...
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_5_A: Destruction. Infection. The dead. Radiation. You've told me about all of it.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_5_Q: If we were really outside, there would be...
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_6_A: Yes. Many times. It's alright if you don't remember. Each time, we make a little more progress. But you always choose to go back.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_7_A: For a long time, the Ark was the only one you had.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_8_A: This place is real, and everything you are experiencing now is real.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_8_Q: This doesn't feel real. I must be dreaming again.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_9_A: You came back. More precisely, your mind did.
IGUI_Dial_Noah_Whitlock_9_Q: If this is real then how did I get in here?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GoToBase: Alright. Got it. I'll head over to the base.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_001: I used to love Romero movies... I can't enjoy them anymore.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_003: Did you hear the screaming last night? No? Then never mind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_004: Dead, but not dead. Strange, isn't it?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_005: Must be the wind. The stench is awful today.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_006: Ever been to Texas? It was more dangerous than this place.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_007: You hear that? They say Osaka, Japan managed to quarantine itself.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_008: Chemicals, viruses, aliens... what do you think caused this?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_009: So this is The Last Man on Earth, huh?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_010: After a fight, that's when I get scared. You'll believe me if I say I wasn't bitten, right?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_011: If you get bitten, don't hide it. That's how communities fall apart.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_012: I dream about killing people I loved. I wish it had only been a dream.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_013: Believe it or not, they used to call me "Mad."
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_014: I'm done being a zombie movie fan. I'm switching to shark movies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_015: Don't wear headphones. You'll get bitten from behind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_016: If this pandemic ever ends... no, I won't say the rest.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_017: Let's not start fighting each other, alright? That's the boring part of the story.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_018: I saw it. The day before this started, something came down from the sky... never mind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_020: Oh, it's you. Thought you were a zombie.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_021: I once killed three zombies with one bullet. You don't believe me, do you?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_022: I once killed three zombies with one swing. That one's a lie.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_023: Don't get careless. If you do, I can't afford to.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_024: Zombies don't have anywhere to go either. That's why they wander around.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_025: What do we call them? Zombies? Undead? Infected?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_026: There's a game I never finished. I want to go get it someday.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_027: Shoot. Swing. The world's gotten real simple.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_028: Should've prepared a mohawk and spiked shoulder pads.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_029: Rumor says the military's gathering in California. Rumor says.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_030: You think this is God's test?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_031: When there's no more room in Hell, huh?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_032: You only realize how good it is to have people around when you're alone.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_033: This is the first time I've ever been grateful for gun culture.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_034: Thanks for letting me join you. Just... don't kick me out, alright?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_035: Do you count your shots? You should.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_036: Check your gear before we head out. You always forget something.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_037: The world's gone to hell, but sometimes... sometimes it's still kind of fun.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_038: We smell almost as bad as they do.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_039: I want something sweet. Something spicy, too...
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_042: We should burn the bodies. Sorry, Jesus, but we can't have them coming back.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_043: I'm worried about my cousin. Knowing him, he might be eating the zombies instead.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_044: I'm looking for a friend I got separated from. I hope I don't find them in the horde.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_045: Cough! Cough! ...What? It's just a cough.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_046: I saw a zombie holding a sign that said \"Zombie Rights.\"
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_047: I once saw a drunk walking with a pack of zombies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_048: You're the leader. Keep it together.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_049: I heard a zombie bit Chuck Norris, suffered for a while, then died.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_050: Their teeth can bite through clothes. Be careful.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_051: Someone who used to mock me died. Strangely enough, I was sad.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_052: Someone stopped by earlier. They were already dead, so I killed them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_053: That thing you ate yesterday... no, I won't say it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_054: A zombie bit me once, but it had dentures. Lucky me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_055: I hear some people are trying to control the zombies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_056: I can't name every president, but I know the next one. A zombie.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_057: If we held an election now, the zombies would win.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_058: I think zombies still carry habits from when they were alive.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_060: Maybe their goal isn't to eat us. Maybe it's to make more of themselves.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_061: There's no Superman. No Batman. So we have to fight.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_062: I've thought \"this is it\" a hundred times. Still here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_063: I've become prejudiced against zombies. Funny thing is, we're the minority now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_064: What's your favorite gun? ...That's a pretty old-school choice.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_066: What's your favorite movie? ...Didn't expect that. You watch that kind of thing?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_067: What's your favorite comic? ...Yeah, that's a cool one.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_068: Who taught you to shoot? Bruce Willis?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_069: That swing of yours is something else. Babe Ruth reincarnated, maybe?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_070: You're a good person. So I'll try to be one too.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_071: I still haven't gotten used to the feeling of cutting a zombie with a knife.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_072: I like crushing zombie heads. Splat!
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_073: I'm fine with bringing in more people, but choose carefully.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_074: There were crows gathering in the woods. Means there's a body out there.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_075: Did you see a helicopter in the distance? No? ...Right.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_076: Someone said they saw a ten-foot zombie. Probably just saw wrong.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_077: I heard about a guy who walked straight through a horde. Then one day he tripped and died.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_078: Got any funny stories? ...Yeah, I heard that one already.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_079: Got any funny stories? ...Never heard that one. Don't care, though.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_080: Got any funny stories? ...Ha! No, wait. It wasn't that funny.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_081: There was a pebble in my shoe. It's always the little things that ruin your life.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_082: Sometimes there are smart ones mixed in with the zombies. Don't get careless.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_083: Sometimes there are fast ones mixed in with the zombies. Don't get careless.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_084: Aim for the head. Not mine. The zombie's.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_085: Head's worth 100 points, torso's 50, arms are 20. Sound fair?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_086: I heard survivors are gathering at the Gigamart. Zombies too, obviously.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_087: If you die, I die too.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_088: Cats or dogs? ...Huh. So that's your answer.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_089: This place might be worse than medieval London.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_090: Sometimes I wonder if they're really dead.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_091: Don't try to be a hero. You'll die.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_092: Maybe we're all standing on the edge between life and death. Us and them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_093: A .44's the way to go. Dirty Harry carried one.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_094: Careful. This is the Wild West now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_095: Bang! Bang! Bang! How's my quick draw?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_096: Ever been to the West Coast? I haven't. Let's drive there someday.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_097: They say in Heaven, everybody talks about the ocean.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_098: If it comes down to it, leave me behind. I won't leave you, though.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_099: Guess we're back to the frontier days. Want to plant an apple tree?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_100: I once shot at someone thinking they were a zombie. Good thing I missed.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_101: I'm tired... I can't remember the last time I wasn't.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_102: When I wake up, the first thing I do is check my hands.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_103: I can eat meat in the middle of that rotten stink now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_104: Choose the base location carefully. Please don't build it in the middle of a desert.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_105: The night is too quiet. Put on some club music or something.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_106: I once knew a guy who put poisonous mushrooms in a stew. You be careful too.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_107: Do you know what bleach tastes like? I don't want to.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_108: Drive safely, all right? I'd hate to die in some stupid car crash.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_109: Someone said they saw a zombie climbing up the wall of a building. You believe that?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_110: If you want to survive, make rules.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_111: Darkness, corners... those things are good at hiding their presence.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_112: Look around before throwing bombs. Don't blow up the house, okay?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_113: Burning zombies are dangerous. They keep walking while they're on fire.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_114: Someone said they saw a zombie dodge bullets. You believe that?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_115: Someone said they saw a zombie with no head. You believe that?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_116: If you've got time, load some rounds into the magazines.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_117: Was that you banging on the wall last night?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_118: Shotguns are powerful, but they call in a lot of zombies. Don't use them at the wrong time.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_119: Magazines everywhere and no gun! Should we throw the magazines at them?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_120: Don't forget to turn off your flashlight.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_121: The sole of your boot is the strongest weapon.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_122: Splitting a zombie's head open in one hit is harder than it looks. There's a trick to it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_123: When you use a knife, don't carve them up. Drive it in with one clean thrust.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_124: If I turn into a zombie, then when that time comes... let's become zombies together, yeah?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_125: You're marking things on the map, right? Don't get lost.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_126: I hate the cold, and I hate the heat.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_128: Keep your eyes on the road when you're driving, okay?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_129: I heard the Navy is taking survivors to some island.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_130: How many zombies have you killed so far? Me... I stopped counting.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_131: There was a Japanese guy fighting zombies with a katana. In the end, he died by seppuku.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_132: Listen, don't ever sneak up behind me. I might kill you by accident.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_133: I saw a rich guy get attacked and shove a wad of cash into a zombie's mouth before beating it to death.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_134: Even when civilization ends, some things never change.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_135: I saw a preacher trying to enlighten a zombie. The zombie listened for a while... then bit him.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_136: Only open canned food when you're ready to eat it. It'll spoil.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_137: Don't say it's just your imagination. If something feels off, check it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_138: One day, a bomb might fall and end everything... maybe that day will come.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_139: Collect books for me. I get bored when we're at the base.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_140: Persistent bastards. They follow you anywhere.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_141: Apparently they can't swim. They won't come into the river. Well, neither can we...
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_142: Don't look for romance in a gun. This is real combat.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_143: At least we probably don't have to worry about World War III anymore.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_144: Which are you better with, knives or guns? ...I see. So that's why you're so bad.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_145: A chef is absolutely necessary. Food rules everything.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_146: There were so many things I wanted to do before all this... guess that's not happening now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_147: Put some seasoning in the food, will you? I hate tasteless meals.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_148: Sometimes I feel like pointing the barrel at myself instead of the zombies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_149: I'm glad there aren't zombies running at us with bombs strapped to their bodies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_150: Building a home means being ready to fight for it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_151: There's something I always keep with me... wait, where did it go?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_152: I'm on cooking duty today. You don't have any picky eating habits, right?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_153: There's a zombie corpse lying around. Put it out on garbage day, will you?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_154: If you find batteries, bring them back. I want to play my Game Boy.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_155: Damn it, I just remembered I returned a video without rewinding it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_156: All right, watch up, down, front, back, left, and right. I'll have a smoke.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_157: Hey, you're not hiding cigarettes from me, are you?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_158: Whatever happens, don't panic. That 0.1 second can be what kills you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_159: I just saw an insanely beautiful woman... she was a zombie.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_160: That zombie I saw the other day was that famous... no? Oh. Never mind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_161: In this world of slowpokes, I'm Carl Lewis.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_162: Under the bed, inside the closet, in the back seat... they can be anywhere, so stay sharp.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_163: Let me drive next time. My license got revoked, but still.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_164: That whiskey you hid under the bed? Sorry, I drank it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_165: I keep one bullet in my pocket... you know why, right?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_166: Don't run too much. You'll trip.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_167: You brought the travel itinerary, right?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_168: Where are we headed today? Disneyland?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_169: I keep dreaming that I wake up inside a coffin.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_170: They can see in the dark. Even if we can't see them, they can see us.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_171: That blood on you... oh, it's just zombie blood.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_172: It's easy to blame someone. Easy, and that's all.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_173: Luckily, our group doesn't fight with each other. Lucky us.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_174: Left or right... it's always a tough choice.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_175: They say meat tastes better when it's almost rotten, right?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_176: Once, I ate a huge hamburger and my jaw popped out. How do those things keep theirs attached?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_177: A doctor is absolutely necessary. A doctor who isn't a zombie, I mean.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_178: Don't stick your muzzle out around a corner. Basic room clearing.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_180: Let's play chess sometime. The rules? We'll make them up.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_181: Let's play poker sometime with the cards I made.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_182: Give me a better house, will you? Something like the White House.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_183: If you find a tank, tell me. I always wanted to ride one.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_184: Don't get careless just because we have walls. Everything has a lifespan.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_185: Always stay cool. That's how you survive.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_186: Walk quietly. Like a cat, like a ninja...
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_187: Watch out for smells too, not just sounds... What? Your nose is stuffed and you can't smell anything?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_188: The people back at base bring in all kinds of items. Check on them once in a while.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_189: I won't fight if you're not nearby, so keep that in mind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_190: Are you organizing the containers properly? I found a gun in the fridge.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_191: Are you organizing the containers properly? I found food in the armory.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_192: Could you please stop cooking with the same frying pan you used to beat a zombie?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_193: There's a dessert on the shelf. A Desert Eagle, I mean.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_194: Put curtains on the windows, will you? I can't relax like this.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_195: Please don't make this place a house made of nothing but containers.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_196: Please don't make this place a square box of a house.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_197: Stop leaving every damn thing on the floor.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_198: Don't go out on rainy days. It covers up every sign of the zombies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_199: Dry your wet clothes properly. You'll catch a cold.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_200: Sorry, I'm bad at locking up.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_RecruitResponse: Thanks for having me. I'll follow your lead.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye: I don't want to be alone. Please don't leave me behind.
Please, take me with you. I swear I'll be useful.
I can fight and scavenge. I won't be a burden.

IGUI_PD_AlertFullDesc: Full watch over the whole sentinel range. A quiet growl for distant or few zombies; a loud bark for close, many or visible ones - and that bark draws zombies (the trade-off). The default.
IGUI_PD_AlertQuietDesc: Stealth watch: only a small nearby ring, and never more than a quiet growl and a halo - no loud bark, no noise that draws zombies. A discreet heads-up that won't give away your position.
IGUI_PD_AlertSilentDesc: No zombie alerts at all from this %1's sentinel. (Its stress barking from hunger or injury is separate and still happens.)
IGUI_PD_AutoProtectDesc: Your %1 stands guard while you do something that leaves you defenseless - sleeping, eating, reading, sitting or fishing. It anchors next to you and fights zombies off, then goes back to following the moment you're done. Fighting like this stresses the dog (it barks and draws zombies) and earns no loyalty, so use it wisely. Off by default; toggle it per dog.
IGUI_PD_BadFood: Bad for dogs - eating this makes it sick and breaks its trust.
IGUI_PD_BagMapNoAnnot: Map markings aren't kept in the saddlebag.

IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_caramelo: The caramelo is a basic, everyday breed - the mongrel you find all over the cities. It has no special skills and is weak by nature: it can't kill a zombie on its own, only knock one down to buy you time. The plain baseline that future breeds will improve on.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_germanshepherd: A powerful, intelligent working dog. Born far stronger and tougher than the caramelo, it learns Combat and Obedience quickly, barely frays in a fight (a third of the stress), holds the line against a swarm without panicking, and can bring a zombie down on its own. Rare - found around police and military buildings.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_husky: A hardy northern sled dog: by far the strongest breed, built to haul cargo (its saddlebag carries the most) and to survive the cold. It learns Combat a little faster than the caramelo and can bring a zombie down, but it is no warrior. Stubborn (slower to learn Obedience), friendly (a poor guard) and a big eater (gets hungry fast). Rare - found only in the cold of winter, and at pet shops and vets.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_retriever: A friendly, keen-nosed gun dog and a natural hunter: it learns Hunting twice as fast and Combat a little faster than the caramelo, and can bring a zombie down on its own (though it frays more easily than the German Shepherd). Its nose helps you forage and track game from farther away. Uncommon - turns up now and then in residential houses.
IGUI_PD_BtnReleaseDesc: Send your companion back to the wild. It keeps its training and skills, so you can tame it again later.
IGUI_PD_BtnRenameDesc: Give your companion a custom name (up to 30 characters). It sticks through save and reload.
IGUI_PD_CmdFetchDesc: Whistle your %1 to teleport instantly to your side - for when it is stuck or loaded but too far to walk back. The loud whistle draws zombies, the cost of an instant recall.
IGUI_PD_CmdFollowDesc: The %1 paths along behind you and fights zombies that get close. Its sentinel keeps watch. The default - your companion on the move.
IGUI_PD_CmdGuardDesc: The %1 anchors to this exact spot and defends it - engaging zombies in a wider radius, alerting, then returning to its post after a chase. It backs off behind you if surrounded. (For now it only works while you are nearby.)
IGUI_PD_CmdStayDesc: The %1 holds its position and won't follow. It still senses and warns about zombies, but it won't chase or fight - it just sits and watches. Good for parking it somewhere safe.

IGUI_PD_GeneDesc_aggressiveness: Fighting drive. A more aggressive %1 earns combat XP faster, so it learns to fight quicker. It does not change when the %1 decides to engage or retreat.
IGUI_PD_GeneDesc_resistance: Toughness. Higher Resistance keeps the %1 calmer under fire, so it gains less stress while fighting.
IGUI_PD_GeneDesc_strength: Raw muscle. Higher Strength makes the %1 hit a little harder in combat.
IGUI_PD_GenomeDesc: Inborn genes, fixed for life - rolled when the %1 is tamed and varying from one to the next. Unlike skills they never change with training; they are the raw nature this %1 was born with.
IGUI_PD_HuntDelivered: Your %1 dragged its kill to you.
IGUI_PD_HuntModeDesc: When on, your %1 tracks wild game while following you and - once trained enough - chases it down: killing small game for you and wearing large game like deer down for you to finish. Hunting is a rural activity (you find game in forests and the countryside, not in town). The cost is symmetric: the dog leaves your side and is exposed, the chase barks and can draw zombies, large game can hurt it, it can wander off, and hunting works up an appetite. Off by default; toggle it per dog.
IGUI_PD_HuntTrackWounded: Your %1 is tracking the wounded game...
IGUI_PD_HuntWoundedDeer: Your %1 wounded a deer - finish it off!
IGUI_PD_KennelRecallConfirm: Call %1 back from afar? Your loud whistle will draw zombies.
IGUI_PD_KennelStatusNoData: No record yet, visit this dog once
IGUI_PD_KennelTooltip: All your bonded dogs - even the ones far away.
IGUI_PD_LoyaltyDesc: How much the %1 trusts you. It slowly fades over time - faster while it's hungry or thirsty - and is restored by feeding, giving water and petting. If it drops too low the %1 turns disobedient, refusing to follow or fight until you win it back. The Obedience skill keeps it reliable at lower loyalty.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BreedHappy_desc: The Caramelo is a wonderfully affectionate, charismatic mutt - its loyal company lifts your spirits, so sadness and boredom fade faster while it's near.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_GSCourage_desc: A bold German Shepherd at your side steadies your nerves - its fearless presence eases your panic while it stays close.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_GoldenNose_desc: Your Golden Retriever works the ground with you. While it stays close, fed and loyal, you spot forage from farther away and learn Foraging, Trapping and Aiming faster.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Hunger_desc: Your dog is hungry. Feed it before its health starts to suffer.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Rested_desc: You slept soundly with your dog watching over you. For a while you feel calm and rested - panic, stress, sadness and boredom fade faster, and you tire more slowly.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Sick_desc: You fed it something dogs shouldn't eat - your dog is intoxicated and feeling ill.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Thirst_desc: Your dog is thirsty. Give it water before its health starts to suffer.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Warmed_desc: Your husky pulls its weight at your side. While it stays close, fed and loyal, it shoulders a little of your load so you can carry more and helps you keep your wind, so you tire more slowly; and when the cold sets in, its thick coat keeps you warm.
IGUI_PD_NeedDesc_health: The %1's life. Fighting no longer wounds it (that only stresses it) - health falls only from real neglect, as severe hunger or thirst drains it, and at zero it dies for good. It heals slowly while fed, watered and out of combat.
IGUI_PD_NeedDesc_hunger: Rises over time; feeding lowers it. Hunger throttles healing - a fed %1 recovers wounds fastest, the recovery slows as hunger climbs and stops once it passes the halfway mark. Very high hunger also drains the %1's health directly.
IGUI_PD_NeedDesc_stress: Builds from hunger, thirst, low loyalty and FIGHTING - every strike agitates the %1, more when it's swarmed. A stressed %1 barks on its own, drawing zombies; if it peaks into panic it won't fight, guard or keep watch - though it still flees to you when you call it. Combat stress winds down on its own out of a fight, and petting, feeding or watering calms it faster. The Stress gene sets how easily it frays.
IGUI_PD_NeedDesc_thirst: Rises over time; giving water lowers it. Like hunger, thirst throttles natural healing - the thirstier the %1, the slower it recovers, stopping past the halfway mark. Severe thirst also drains its health directly.

IGUI_PD_ResetSpawnsTip: Clears the saved per-building spawn decisions so stray dogs can appear again across the map. Each building re-rolls on its next chunk load - for areas already loaded, move away and back (or relog).
IGUI_PD_Sick: The %1 gets sick from the bad food.
IGUI_PD_SkillDesc_combat: Fighting prowess. Raises the damage it deals and toughens it against bites while it fights.
IGUI_PD_SkillDesc_hunt: The dog's hunting instinct. It levels up by pointing game and foraging. L0: points game and sniffs out frogs/bugs. L3: takes small game (rabbit, raccoon). L6: takes on deer and brings the kill back.
IGUI_PD_SkillDesc_obedience: Discipline and training. Keeps the %1 reliable at lower loyalty, lowering its disobey threshold.
IGUI_PD_SkillDesc_scent: The %1's nose. A higher Scent widens its sentinel range, sensing zombies from farther away.
IGUI_PD_WoundedCritical: Your %1 is badly wounded - it will only follow until it heals.
